import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";

// Kill switch. Set MAINTENANCE=1 in env and redeploy (or flip in Vercel and redeploy).
// /api/health always works so uptime checks keep running.
export function middleware(req: NextRequest) {
  if (process.env.MAINTENANCE !== "1") return NextResponse.next();

  const { pathname } = req.nextUrl;
  if (pathname === "/api/health") return NextResponse.next();

  if (pathname.startsWith("/api/")) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "maintenance" },
      { status: 503, headers: { "Retry-After": "300", "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
    );
  }

  const url = req.nextUrl.clone();
  url.pathname = "/maintenance";
  return NextResponse.rewrite(url, { status: 503 });
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp|ico|css|js)$).*)"],
};

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

// Last line of defense. Any render error shows this friendly page instead of a crash screen.
export default function Error({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error(error);
  }, [error]);
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-32 text-center">
      <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-bold">Something hiccuped</h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-mute">Your coins and donations are safe on chain. Try again in a moment.</p>
      <button onClick={reset} className="btn mt-8">Try again</button>
    </div>
  );
}

  | ({ action: "save" } & CharityInput)
  | { action: "verify" | "unverify" | "activate" | "deactivate"; slug: string };

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const denied = adminGuard(req);
  if (denied) return denied;
  const limited = await guard(req, "admin-write", 60, 60);
  if (limited) return limited;

  let b: Body;
  try {
    b = (await req.json()) as Body;
  } catch {
    return noStore({ error: "Bad JSON" }, 400);
  }

  try {
    switch (b.action) {
      case "save":
        return noStore({ charity: await saveCharity(b) });
      case "verify":
        await setCharityVerified(b.slug, true);
        return noStore({ ok: true });
      case "unverify":
        await setCharityVerified(b.slug, false);
        return noStore({ ok: true });
      case "activate":
        await setCharityActive(b.slug, true);
        return noStore({ ok: true });
      case "deactivate":
        await setCharityActive(b.slug, false);
        return noStore({ ok: true });
      default:
        return noStore({ error: "Unknown action" }, 400);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof AdminError) return noStore({ error: e.message }, e.status);
    console.error("admin charities", (e as Error).message);
    return noStore({ error: "Server error" }, 500);
  }
}

import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { COOKIE, adminConfigured, checkPassword, makeSession } from "@/lib/admin/auth";
import { guard } from "@/lib/ratelimit";
import { noStore } from "@/lib/http";
import { sleep } from "@/lib/util";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  // 6 tries per 5 minutes per IP. Slows guessing to a crawl.
  const limited = await guard(req, "adminlogin", 6, 300);
  if (limited) return limited;
  if (!adminConfigured()) return noStore({ error: "Admin is not configured" }, 503);

  let password = "";
  try {
    password = String(((await req.json()) as { password?: string }).password ?? "");
  } catch {
    return noStore({ error: "Bad request" }, 400);
  }

  if (!checkPassword(password)) {
    await sleep(400);
    return noStore({ error: "Wrong password" }, 401);
  }

  const s = makeSession();
  cookies().set(COOKIE, s.value, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "strict",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: s.maxAge,
  });
  return noStore({ ok: true });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { store } from "@/lib/store";
import { kvPing } from "@/lib/kv";
import { snapshotAge } from "@/lib/snapshot";
import { dbBreaker } from "@/lib/breaker";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

let last: { at: number; body: Record<string, unknown>; code: number } | null = null;

// Public health check for uptime monitors. Minimal on purpose. Detailed status is in the admin dashboard.
// Result is memoized 10s per instance so pings never load the database.
export async function GET() {
  const maintenance = process.env.MAINTENANCE === "1";
  if (last && Date.now() - last.at < 10_000) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ...last.body, maintenance }, { status: last.code });
  }

  const s = store();
  const [dbOk, kv, homeAge] = await Promise.all([
    s.kind !== "memory" ? s.ping() : Promise.resolve(null),
    kvPing(),
    snapshotAge("home"),
  ]);

  // The site can serve while the DB is down as long as snapshots exist. Only report down when it cannot.
  const canServe = dbOk !== false || homeAge !== null;
  const status = !canServe ? "down" : dbOk === false || !kv.ok || dbBreaker.isOpen ? "degraded" : "ok";
  const body = { ok: canServe, status, time: new Date().toISOString() };
  const code = canServe ? 200 : 503;
  last = { at: Date.now(), body, code };
  return NextResponse.json({ ...body, maintenance }, { status: code });
}

import { Keypair, PublicKey, VersionedTransaction } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { MIN_CHARITY_BPS, MAX_CHARITY_BPS, platformBps, platformWallet } from "@/lib/config";
import { isSelectable, loadCharitiesFresh } from "@/lib/charities";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 30;

const MAX_IMG = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DEV_BUY_SOL = 10;
const IMG_TYPES = ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/gif", "image/webp"];

// Accepts a full https link, or for X and Telegram a bare handle. Returns "" when empty, null when invalid.
function cleanLink(raw: string, kind: "web" | "x" | "tg"): string | null {
  let v = raw.trim().slice(0, 200);
  if (!v) return "";
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(v)) {
    if (kind === "x" && /^@?[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}$/.test(v)) v = `https://x.com/${v.replace(/^@/, "")}`;
    else if (kind === "tg" && /^@?[A-Za-z0-9_]{4,32}$/.test(v)) v = `https://t.me/${v.replace(/^@/, "")}`;
    else v = `https://${v}`;
  }
  try {
    const u = new URL(v);
    if (u.protocol !== "https:" && u.protocol !== "http:") return null;
    if (!u.hostname.includes(".")) return null;
    return u.toString();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function bad(msg: string, status = 400) {
  return noStore({ error: msg }, status);
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const limited = await guard(req, "prepare", 8, 60);
  if (limited) return limited;
  if (!store().writable) return bad("Launching is not available right now", 503);

  const flags = await getFlags();
  if (flags.launchPaused) return bad("Launches are paused for a moment. Try again shortly.", 503);

  let form: FormData;
  try {
    form = await req.formData();
  } catch {
    return bad("Expected multipart form");
  }

  const creatorStr = String(form.get("creator") ?? "");
  const name = String(form.get("name") ?? "").trim();
  const symbol = String(form.get("symbol") ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const description = String(form.get("description") ?? "").trim().slice(0, 500);
  const website = cleanLink(String(form.get("website") ?? ""), "web");
  const twitter = cleanLink(String(form.get("twitter") ?? ""), "x");
  const telegram = cleanLink(String(form.get("telegram") ?? ""), "tg");
  if (website === null) return bad("Website link is not valid");
  if (twitter === null) return bad("X link is not valid");
  if (telegram === null) return bad("Telegram link is not valid");
  const devBuyRaw = String(form.get("devBuy") ?? "").trim();
  const devBuySol = devBuyRaw === "" ? 0 : Number(devBuyRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(devBuySol) || devBuySol < 0 || devBuySol > MAX_DEV_BUY_SOL)
    return bad(`Dev buy must be between 0 and ${MAX_DEV_BUY_SOL} SOL`);
  const devBuyLamports = BigInt(Math.round(devBuySol * 1e9));
  const charitySlug = String(form.get("charitySlug") ?? "");
  const charityBps = Math.round(Number(form.get("charityPercent")) * 100);
  const image = form.get("image");

  let creator: PublicKey;
  try {
    creator = new PublicKey(creatorStr);
  } catch {
    return bad("Invalid wallet");
  }
  if (name.length < 1 || name.length > 32) return bad("Name must be 1 to 32 characters");
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{1,10}$/.test(symbol)) return bad("Symbol must be 1 to 10 letters or numbers");
  if (!Number.isFinite(charityBps) || charityBps < MIN_CHARITY_BPS || charityBps > MAX_CHARITY_BPS)
    return bad("Charity share must be between 50 and 100 percent");

  // Fresh read, not the cached snapshot: an admin deactivating a charity must take effect immediately.
  let charity;
  try {
    charity = (await loadCharitiesFresh()).find((c) => c.slug === charitySlug);
  } catch {
    return bad("Service busy, try again", 503);
  }
  if (!charity || !isSelectable(charity)) return bad("Charity is not available");

  if (!(image instanceof File) || image.size === 0) return bad("Image required");
  if (image.size > MAX_IMG) return bad("Image must be under 2MB");
  if (!IMG_TYPES.includes(image.type)) return bad("Image must be png, jpg, gif or webp");

  let shares;
  try {
    shares = computeShares({
      devWallet: creator.toBase58(),
      charityWallet: charity.wallet,
      charityBps,
      platformWallet: platformWallet(),
      platformBps: platformBps(),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return bad((e as Error).message);
  }

  // Upload image and metadata to IPFS (Pinata first if configured, pump.fun as fallback)
  let uri: string;
  let imageUrl: string | null = null;
  try {
    const m = await uploadMetadata({ file: image, name, symbol, description, website, twitter, telegram });
    uri = m.uri;
    imageUrl = m.imageUrl;
  } catch (e) {
    // The detail names the failing route and its HTTP status. It never contains keys.
    const detail = e instanceof MetaError ? e.detail : "unknown";
    return bad(`Could not upload metadata (${detail}). Try again.`, 502);
  }

  const mintKp = Keypair.generate();
  try {
    const built = await buildLaunchTransactions(
      getConnection(),
      { creator, mint: mintKp.publicKey, name, symbol, uri, shares },
      mintKp,
      devBuyLamports,
    );

    const ticket = signTicket({
      mint: mintKp.publicKey.toBase58(),
      creator: creator.toBase58(),
      name,
      symbol,
      image: imageUrl,
      description,
      charitySlug: charity.slug,
      charityBps,
    });

    return noStore({
      mint: mintKp.publicKey.toBase58(),
      // One time throwaway key for this coin. It holds no funds. The browser signs with it after the wallet.
      mintSecret: Buffer.from(mintKp.secretKey).toString("base64"),
      ticket,
      lastValidBlockHeights: built.txs.map(() => built.lastValidBlockHeight),
      versioned: built.txs.map((t) => t instanceof VersionedTransaction),
      transactions: built.txs.map((t) =>
        (t instanceof VersionedTransaction ? Buffer.from(t.serialize()) : t.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false })).toString("base64"),
      ),
      split: shares.map((s) => ({ address: s.address.toBase58(), bps: s.shareBps })),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof LutMissingError) return bad("Dev buy is not available yet. Set it to 0 to launch.", 503);
    if (e instanceof TooLargeError) return bad("Your name or ticker is too long to include a dev buy. Shorten it, or set the dev buy to 0.", 400);
    console.error("build launch failed", (e as Error).message);
    return bad("Could not build launch transaction", 500);
  }
}

import { PublicKey } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { platformWallet } from "@/lib/config";
import { isSelectable, loadCharitiesFresh } from "@/lib/charities";

import { verifyOnChain } from "@/lib/pump";
import { getConnection } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { verifyTicket } from "@/lib/token";
import { noStore } from "@/lib/http";
import { guard } from "@/lib/ratelimit";
import { invalidateSnapshot } from "@/lib/snapshot";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 30;

// Called by the browser after both launch transactions are sent.
// Trusts nothing from the client except the signed ticket. Charity split is read from chain.
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const limited = await guard(req, "register", 40, 60);
  if (limited) return limited;
  const s = store();
  if (!s.writable) return noStore({ error: "Not available" }, 503);

  let body: { ticket?: string; signature?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return noStore({ error: "Bad JSON" }, 400);
  }

  const t = body.ticket ? verifyTicket(body.ticket) : null;
  if (!t) return noStore({ error: "Invalid or expired ticket" }, 400);

  let charity;
  try {
    charity = (await loadCharitiesFresh()).find((c) => c.slug === t.charitySlug);
  } catch {
    return noStore({ error: "Service busy" }, 503);
  }
  if (!charity || !isSelectable(charity)) return noStore({ error: "Charity unavailable" }, 400);

  const mint = new PublicKey(t.mint);
  const v = await verifyOnChain(getConnection(), mint, charity.wallet);

  // Not on chain yet or not finished. Client keeps polling.
  if (v.shareholders.length === 0) return noStore({ status: "pending", reasons: v.reasons }, 202);

  const charityEntry = v.shareholders.find((x) => x.address === charity.wallet);
  // Never store a coin whose on chain charity share is missing or under 50 percent.
  if (!charityEntry || charityEntry.shareBps < 5000) return noStore({ status: "rejected", reasons: v.reasons }, 422);

  const plat = platformWallet();
  const platEntry = plat ? v.shareholders.find((x) => x.address === plat) : undefined;

  try {
    await s.upsertCoin({
      mint: t.mint,
      name: t.name,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      image_url: t.image,
      description: t.description,
      creator_wallet: t.creator,
      charity_slug: charity.slug,
      charity_wallet: charity.wallet,
      charity_bps: charityEntry.shareBps,
      platform_bps: platEntry?.shareBps ?? 0,
      status: v.ok ? "verified" : "pending",
      fail_reason: v.ok ? null : v.reasons.join("; "),
      launch_signature: body.signature ?? null,
      verified_at: v.ok ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
      last_checked_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("register upsert", (e as Error).message);
    return noStore({ error: "Could not save" }, 500);
  }

  // Clear any cached "not found" so the coin page works the moment the user is redirected.
  await invalidateSnapshot(`coin:${t.mint}`);
  // Same for the lists, so a verified coin shows on Explore and Home straight away.
  if (v.ok) await Promise.all([invalidateSnapshot("explore"), invalidateSnapshot("home")]);
  return noStore({ status: v.ok ? "verified" : "pending", mint: t.mint, reasons: v.reasons }, v.ok ? 200 : 202);
}

import { isSelectable, loadCharitiesFresh } from "@/lib/charities";
import { computeShares } from "@/lib/shares";
import { buildLaunchInstructions, feeSharingConfigPda, bondingCurvePda } from "@/lib/pump";
import { getConnection } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { verifyTicket } from "@/lib/token";
import { noStore } from "@/lib/http";
import { guard } from "@/lib/ratelimit";
import { store } from "@/lib/store";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 20;

// Recovery for the one awkward case: the coin was created but the lock transaction expired or failed.
// Rebuilds only the lock transaction with a fresh blockhash. The creator signs once and it is done.
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const limited = await guard(req, "resume", 10, 60);
  if (limited) return limited;
  if (!store().writable) return noStore({ error: "Not available" }, 503);

  let body: { ticket?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return noStore({ error: "Bad JSON" }, 400);
  }
  const t = body.ticket ? verifyTicket(body.ticket) : null;
  if (!t) return noStore({ error: "This launch expired. Start a new one." }, 400);

  const conn = getConnection();
  const mint = new PublicKey(t.mint);
  const creator = new PublicKey(t.creator);

  const [curve, cfg] = await Promise.all([
    conn.getAccountInfo(bondingCurvePda(mint), "confirmed"),
    conn.getAccountInfo(feeSharingConfigPda(mint), "confirmed"),
  ]);
  if (!curve) return noStore({ error: "Coin not found on chain yet" }, 409);
  if (cfg) return noStore({ status: "already_locked" });

  const charity = (await loadCharitiesFresh()).find((c) => c.slug === t.charitySlug);
  if (!charity || !isSelectable(charity)) return noStore({ error: "Charity unavailable" }, 400);

  try {
    const shares = computeShares({
      devWallet: creator.toBase58(),
      charityWallet: charity.wallet,
      charityBps: t.charityBps,
      platformWallet: platformWallet(),
      platformBps: platformBps(),
    });
    const { share } = await buildLaunchInstructions({
      creator,
      mint,
      name: t.name,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      uri: "",
      shares,
    });
    const { blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } = await conn.getLatestBlockhash("confirmed");
    const tx = new Transaction({ feePayer: creator, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight });
    tx.add(...share);
    return noStore({
      transaction: tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false }).toString("base64"),
      lastValidBlockHeight,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("resume build failed", (e as Error).message);
    return noStore({ error: "Could not build transaction" }, 500);
  }
}
=== FILE: C:\Users\BENOTOS\Downloads\givefun\src\app\api\rpc\route.ts ===
import { rpcRaw } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { guard } from "@/lib/ratelimit";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 20;

// Browser safe RPC proxy. The wallet flow sends transactions through here so our provider keys
// never reach the browser, and so every call is rate limited and fails over across providers.
const ALLOW = new Set([
  "sendTransaction",
  "simulateTransaction",
  "getLatestBlockhash",
  "getSignatureStatuses",
  "getBlockHeight",
  "getBalance",
  "getAccountInfo",
  "getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption",
  "getFeeForMessage",
  "isBlockhashValid",
  "getRecentPrioritizationFees",
]);
const MAX_BODY = 200_000;

function json(body: unknown, status = 200, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store", ...headers },
  });
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const limited = await guard(req, "rpc", 120, 60);
  if (limited) return limited;

  const text = await req.text();
  if (text.length > MAX_BODY) return json({ error: "Body too large" }, 413);

  let msg: { jsonrpc?: string; id?: unknown; method?: string };
  try {
    msg = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "Bad JSON" }, 400);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(msg) || typeof msg !== "object" || msg === null) return json({ error: "Batches not allowed" }, 400);
  if (!msg.method || !ALLOW.has(msg.method)) {
    return json({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: msg.id ?? null, error: { code: -32601, message: "Method not allowed" } }, 403);
  }

  if (msg.method === "sendTransaction") {
    const l2 = await guard(req, "rpc-send", 15, 60);
    if (l2) return l2;
  }

  try {
    const r = await rpcRaw(text);
    return new Response(r.text, {
      status: r.status,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store" },
    });
  } catch {
    return json({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: msg.id ?? null, error: { code: -32000, message: "RPC unavailable, retry" } }, 503);
  }
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { CHARITY_IMAGES } from "@/data/charity-images";

function domainOf(url: string): string {
  try {
    return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "");
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/** Charity logo tile. Order: your override, the site's own icon, then initials. Never breaks the layout. */
export default function CharityLogo({
  slug,
  name,
  siteUrl,
  size = 56,
  className = "",
}: {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  siteUrl?: string;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const domain = siteUrl ? domainOf(siteUrl) : "";
  const list = [
    CHARITY_IMAGES[slug],
    domain ? `https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}&sz=256` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  const initials = name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-cream shadow-lift ${className}`}
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    >
      {i < list.length ? (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img
          src={list[i]}
          alt={`${name} logo`}
          width={size}
          height={size}
          loading="lazy"
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          onError={() => setI((n) => n + 1)}
          className="h-full w-full object-contain p-2"
        />
      ) : (
        <span className="font-display font-extrabold text-ink" style={{ fontSize: size * 0.36 }}>
          {initials}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { gradientFor } from "@/lib/format";

// Public IPFS gateways are flaky for fresh pins, so try several before falling back to the gradient tile.
const GATEWAYS = ["https://ipfs.io/ipfs/", "https://dweb.link/ipfs/", "https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/", "https://w3s.link/ipfs/"];

// Your own dedicated gateway (Pinata gives one free). Tried first, so old coins load from it too.
const OWN = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_GATEWAY || "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");

function candidates(image: string): string[] {
  const m = image.match(/\/ipfs\/([A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\/[^?#]*)?)/);
  if (!m) return [image];
  const list = [...(OWN ? [`${OWN}/${m[1]}`] : []), image, ...GATEWAYS.map((g) => g + m[1])];
  return Array.from(new Set(list));
}

export default function CoinAvatar({
  mint,
  symbol,
  image,
  size = 48,
  rounded = "rounded-2xl",
}: {
  mint: string;
  symbol: string;
  image: string | null;
  size?: number;
  rounded?: string;
}) {
  const [a, b] = gradientFor(mint);
  const list = image ? candidates(image) : [];
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  if (image && i < list.length) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    return (
      <img
        src={list[i]}
        alt=""
        width={size}
        height={size}
        loading="lazy"
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        onError={() => setI((n) => n + 1)}
        className={`${rounded} shrink-0 object-cover`}
        style={{ width: size, height: size }}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div
      className={`${rounded} flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center font-display font-extrabold text-ink`}
      style={{ width: size, height: size, background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${a}, ${b})`, fontSize: size * 0.34 }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {symbol.slice(0, 2)}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CopyButton({ text, label = "Copy" }: { text: string; label?: string }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          setDone(true);
          setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1400);
        } catch {
          /* clipboard blocked, ignore */
        }
      }}
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-line px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-mute transition hover:border-mute/50 hover:text-cream"
      aria-label={`${label} to clipboard`}
    >
      <Icon name={done ? "check" : "copy"} size={13} />
      {done ? "Copied" : label}
    </button>
  );

=== FILE: C:\Users\BENOTOS\Downloads\givefun\src\components\Counter.tsx ===
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

// Animated number. Counts up the first time it scrolls into view, and tweens smoothly on every change.
export default function Counter({
  value,
  decimals = 0,
  duration = 1400,
  className = "",
}: {
  value: number;
  decimals?: number;
  duration?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const cur = useRef(value);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  const first = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const tween = (from: number, to: number, ms: number) => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      if (reduce || from === to) {
        cur.current = to;
        setShown(to);
        return;
      }
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const step = (t: number) => {
        const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
        const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
        const v = from + (to - from) * e;
        cur.current = v;
        setShown(v);
        if (p < 1) raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      };
      raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };

    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      const el = ref.current;
      if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
        tween(0, value, duration);
        return;
      }
      setShown(0);
      cur.current = 0;
      const io = new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries) => {
          if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
            io.disconnect();
            tween(0, value, duration);
          }
        },
        { threshold: 0.3 },
      );
      io.observe(el);
      return () => {
        io.disconnect();
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
      };
    }
    tween(cur.current, value, 900);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={`tabular-nums ${className}`}>
      {shown.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals })}
    </span>
  );
}

import type { Seg } from "./SplitBar";

export default function Donut({ segs, size = 168, center }: { segs: Seg[]; size?: number; center?: React.ReactNode }) {
  const r = size / 2 - 12;
  const c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  let offset = 0;
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`} className="-rotate-90" role="img" aria-label="Fee split">
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none" stroke="#2a2520" strokeWidth="14" />
        {segs.map((s) => {
          const len = (s.bps / 10000) * c;
          const el = (
            <circle
              key={s.label}
              cx={size / 2}
              cy={size / 2}
              r={r}
              fill="none"
              stroke={s.color}
              strokeWidth="14"
              strokeDasharray={`${Math.max(0, len - 2)} ${c}`}
              strokeDashoffset={-offset}
              strokeLinecap="butt"
            />
          );
          offset += len;
          return el;
        })}
      </svg>
      {center && <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">{center}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { Coin } from "@/lib/store";
import CoinCard from "./CoinCard";

type Opt = { slug: string; name: string };

export default function ExploreClient({ coins, charities }: { coins: Coin[]; charities: Opt[] }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [charity, setCharity] = useState("all");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<"new" | "donated" | "share">("new");
  const names = useMemo(() => new Map(charities.map((c) => [c.slug, c.name])), [charities]);

  const shown = useMemo(() => {
    const t = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = coins.filter(
      (c) =>
        (charity === "all" || c.charity_slug === charity) &&
        (!t || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(t) || c.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(t)),
    );
    const by = {
      new: (a: Coin, b: Coin) => b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at),
      donated: (a: Coin, b: Coin) => b.total_donated_lamports - a.total_donated_lamports,
      share: (a: Coin, b: Coin) => b.charity_bps - a.charity_bps,
    }[sort];
    return [...list].sort(by);
  }, [coins, q, charity, sort]);

  const chip = (on: boolean) =>
    `rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm transition ${on ? "border-ember bg-ember/10 text-cream" : "border-line text-mute hover:text-cream"}`;

  return (
    <div className="mt-8">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <input className="input sm:max-w-xs" placeholder="Search name or ticker" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button type="button" className={chip(sort === "new")} onClick={() => setSort("new")}>Newest</button>
          <button type="button" className={chip(sort === "donated")} onClick={() => setSort("donated")}>Most donated</button>
          <button type="button" className={chip(sort === "share")} onClick={() => setSort("share")}>Highest share</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" className={chip(charity === "all")} onClick={() => setCharity("all")}>All causes</button>
        {charities.map((c) => (
          <button key={c.slug} type="button" className={chip(charity === c.slug)} onClick={() => setCharity(c.slug)}>
            {c.name}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {shown.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card mt-8 p-10 text-center text-mute">{coins.length === 0 ? "No coins yet. Be the first to launch." : "No coins match."}</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {shown.map((c) => (
            <CoinCard key={c.mint} coin={c} charityName={names.get(c.charity_slug)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

// Rising embers and hearts. Sprites are prerendered once, the loop only blits them.
// Pauses when off screen or the tab is hidden. Renders one still frame for reduced motion.

type P = { x: number; y: number; r: number; v: number; sway: number; ph: number; a: number; spr: number; heart: boolean; depth: number };

const COLORS: [string, string][] = [
  ["255,106,69", "255,106,69"],
  ["255,199,102", "255,170,60"],
  ["255,138,161", "255,106,69"],
];

function sprite(rgb: string, size = 64): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = size;
  const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
  const grd = g.createRadialGradient(size / 2, size / 2, 0, size / 2, size / 2, size / 2);
  grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rgb},0.95)`);
  grd.addColorStop(0.25, `rgba(${rgb},0.55)`);
  grd.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${rgb},0)`);
  g.fillStyle = grd;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  return c;
}

function heartPath(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, s: number) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, s * 0.35);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-s, -s * 0.2, -s * 0.5, -s, 0, -s * 0.45);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(s * 0.5, -s, s, -s * 0.2, 0, s * 0.35);
  ctx.closePath();
}

export default function HeroCanvas({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = ref.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const sprites = COLORS.map(([c]) => sprite(c));
    let w = 0, h = 0, raf = 0, last = 0, visible = true, tabOn = !document.hidden;
    let px = 0, py = 0, tx = 0, ty = 0;
    let ps: P[] = [];

    const spawn = (initial: boolean): P => {
      const depth = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.9;
      return {
        x: Math.random() * w,
        y: initial ? Math.random() * h : h + 20 + Math.random() * 60,
        r: (6 + Math.random() * 22) * depth,
        v: (10 + Math.random() * 26) * depth,
        sway: 6 + Math.random() * 22,
        ph: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        a: 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.55,
        spr: Math.floor(Math.random() * sprites.length),
        heart: Math.random() < 0.16,
        depth,
      };
    };

    const resize = () => {
      const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      w = r.width;
      h = r.height;
      canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      const n = Math.round(Math.min(70, Math.max(22, w / 20)));
      ps = Array.from({ length: n }, () => spawn(true));
      draw(0);
    };

    const draw = (t: number) => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      px += (tx - px) * 0.05;
      py += (ty - py) * 0.05;
      for (const p of ps) {
        const x = p.x + Math.sin(t / 1800 + p.ph) * p.sway + px * p.depth * 30;
        const y = p.y + py * p.depth * 20;
        const edge = Math.min(1, y / (h * 0.25), (h - y + 40) / (h * 0.2));
        const alpha = p.a * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, edge));
        if (alpha <= 0.01) continue;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        if (p.heart) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(x, y);
          ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t / 1400 + p.ph) * 0.35);
          ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,138,161,0.9)";
          heartPath(ctx, p.r * 0.55);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        } else {
          const s = sprites[p.spr];
          ctx.drawImage(s, x - p.r, y - p.r, p.r * 2, p.r * 2);
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    };

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      raf = 0;
      if (!visible || !tabOn) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - (last || now)) / 1000);
      last = now;
      for (const p of ps) {
        p.y -= p.v * dt;
        if (p.y < -40) Object.assign(p, spawn(false));
      }
      draw(now);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (reduce || raf || !visible || !tabOn) return;
      last = 0;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      tx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
      ty = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
    };
    const onVis = () => {
      tabOn = !document.hidden;
      if (tabOn) start();
    };

    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
      visible = e.isIntersecting;
      if (visible) start();
    });
    io.observe(canvas);
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    ro.observe(canvas);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    if (!reduce) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: true });

    resize();
    start();

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      io.disconnect();
      ro.disconnect();
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    };
  }, []);

  return <canvas ref={ref} className={`pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full ${className}`} aria-hidden="true" />;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Keypair, Transaction, VersionedTransaction } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { ConnectionProvider, WalletProvider, useConnection, useWallet } from "@solana/wallet-adapter-react";
import { WalletModalProvider, WalletMultiButton } from "@solana/wallet-adapter-react-ui";
import "@solana/wallet-adapter-react-ui/styles.css";
import { confirmByPolling } from "@/lib/confirm";
import { sleep } from "@/lib/util";
import CoinAvatar from "./CoinAvatar";
import Icon from "./Icon";
import CharityLogo from "./CharityLogo";
import SplitBar, { segsFor } from "./SplitBar";

type CharityOpt = { slug: string; name: string; cause: string; blurb: string; site_url?: string };
type Props = { charities: CharityOpt[]; platformBps: number; paused: boolean };

const PENDING_KEY = "givefun:pending-lock";

export default function LaunchClient(props: Props) {
  // All wallet traffic goes through our own rate limited, failover RPC proxy. No provider key in the browser.
  const endpoint = useMemo(() => `${window.location.origin}/api/rpc`, []);
  return (
    <ConnectionProvider endpoint={endpoint} config={{ commitment: "confirmed", disableRetryOnRateLimit: true }}>
      <WalletProvider wallets={[]} autoConnect>
        <WalletModalProvider>
          <Form {...props} />
        </WalletModalProvider>
      </WalletProvider>
    </ConnectionProvider>
  );
}

type Stage = "idle" | "prepare" | "sign" | "create" | "lock" | "verify";
const STAGES: { id: Stage; label: string }[] = [
  { id: "prepare", label: "Preparing" },
  { id: "sign", label: "Approve in wallet" },
  { id: "create", label: "Creating coin" },
  { id: "lock", label: "Locking split" },
  { id: "verify", label: "Verifying" },
];

type PendingLock = { ticket: string; mint: string; at: number };

function Form({ charities, platformBps, paused }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { connection } = useConnection();
  const { publicKey, signAllTransactions, signTransaction } = useWallet();

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [symbol, setSymbol] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");
  const [twitter, setTwitter] = useState("");
  const [telegram, setTelegram] = useState("");
  const [devBuy, setDevBuy] = useState("");
  const [image, setImage] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState(charities[0]?.slug ?? "");
  const [pct, setPct] = useState(70);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>("idle");
  const [err, setErr] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingLock | null>(null);
  const busy = stage !== "idle";
  const urlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const platformPct = platformBps / 100;
  const maxPct = 100 - platformPct;
  const pctClamped = Math.min(pct, maxPct);
  const devPct = Math.max(0, 100 - pctClamped - platformPct);
  const charity = charities.find((c) => c.slug === slug);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PENDING_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const p = JSON.parse(raw) as PendingLock;
        if (Date.now() - p.at < 25 * 60_000) setPending(p);
        else localStorage.removeItem(PENDING_KEY);
      }
    } catch {
      /* storage blocked */
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (urlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
    urlRef.current = image ? URL.createObjectURL(image) : null;
    setPreview(urlRef.current);
    return () => {
      if (urlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
    };
  }, [image]);

  const savePending = (p: PendingLock | null) => {
    setPending(p);
    try {
      if (p) localStorage.setItem(PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify(p));
      else localStorage.removeItem(PENDING_KEY);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  };

  async function sendAndConfirm(tx: Transaction | VersionedTransaction, lastValid: number) {
    const raw = tx.serialize();
    const sig = await connection.sendRawTransaction(raw, { skipPreflight: false, maxRetries: 3 });
    // Keep resending the same signed bytes until it lands or the blockhash expires, so a busy network does not drop it.
    await confirmByPolling(connection, sig, lastValid, 90_000, () => connection.sendRawTransaction(raw, { skipPreflight: true, maxRetries: 0 }));
    return sig;
  }

  async function registerUntilVerified(ticket: string, mint: string, firstSig: string) {
    setStage("verify");
    for (let n = 0; n < 24; n++) {
      const r = await fetch("/api/launch/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ticket, signature: firstSig }),
      });
      const rj = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (r.status === 200 && rj.status === "verified") {
        savePending(null);
        router.push(`/coin/${mint}`);
        return;
      }
      if (r.status === 422) throw new Error("The on chain split did not match, so the coin was not listed.");
      await sleep(3000);
    }
    throw new Error("Launched, but verification is still pending. It will appear shortly.");
  }

  // Asks the server for a lock transaction with a fresh blockhash and has the wallet sign it.
  async function lockFresh(ticket: string) {
    if (!signTransaction) throw new Error("Wallet cannot sign");
    setStage("prepare");
    const res = await fetch("/api/launch/resume", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ ticket }),
    });
    const j = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(j.error || "Could not resume");
    if (j.status === "already_locked") return;
    setStage("sign");
    const signed = await signTransaction(Transaction.from(Buffer.from(j.transaction, "base64")));
    setStage("lock");
    await sendAndConfirm(signed, j.lastValidBlockHeight);
  }

  async function retryLock() {
    if (!pending) return;
    setErr("");
    try {
      await lockFresh(pending.ticket);
      await registerUntilVerified(pending.ticket, pending.mint, "");
    } catch (e) {
      setErr((e as Error).message || "Something went wrong");
    } finally {
      setStage("idle");
    }
  }

  // Shrinks big images in the browser so the upload stays far below the host body limit.
  async function pickImage(f: File | null) {
    setErr("");
    if (!f) return setImage(null);
    const LIMIT = 1.8 * 1024 * 1024;
    if (f.type === "image/gif") {
      if (f.size > LIMIT) { setImage(null); return setErr("GIF is too large. Use one under 2MB."); }
      return setImage(f);
    }
    try {
      const bmp = await createImageBitmap(f);
      const scale = Math.min(1, 1000 / Math.max(bmp.width, bmp.height));
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bmp.width * scale));
      c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bmp.height * scale));
      c.getContext("2d")!.drawImage(bmp, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
      let blob: Blob | null = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, "image/png"));
      if (!blob || blob.size > LIMIT) blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, "image/webp", 0.85));
      if (!blob || blob.size > LIMIT) blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, "image/jpeg", 0.8));
      if (!blob || blob.size > LIMIT) { setImage(null); return setErr("Image is too large. Use a smaller one."); }
      const ext = blob.type === "image/png" ? "png" : blob.type === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpg";
      setImage(new File([blob], `coin.${ext}`, { type: blob.type }));
    } catch {
      f.size > LIMIT ? (setImage(null), setErr("Image is too large. Use one under 2MB.")) : setImage(f);
    }
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr("");
    if (!publicKey || !signAllTransactions) return setErr("Connect your wallet first");
    if (!image) return setErr("Add an image");
    try {
      const bal = await connection.getBalance(publicKey, "confirmed");
      const need = 25_000_000 + Math.round((Number(devBuy) || 0) * 1e9) * 1.03;
      if (bal < need) {
        return setErr(`Your wallet has ${(bal / 1e9).toFixed(4)} SOL. This launch needs about ${(need / 1e9).toFixed(3)} SOL. Add SOL first so nothing is wasted.`);
      }
    } catch { /* balance check is best effort */ }
    let ticket = "";
    let mint = "";
    let created = false;
    try {
      setStage("prepare");
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("creator", publicKey.toBase58());
      fd.append("name", name);
      fd.append("symbol", symbol);
      fd.append("description", description);
      fd.append("website", website);
      fd.append("twitter", twitter);
      fd.append("telegram", telegram);
      fd.append("devBuy", devBuy);
      fd.append("charitySlug", slug);
      fd.append("charityPercent", String(pctClamped));
      fd.append("image", image);
      const res = await fetch("/api/launch/prepare", { method: "POST", body: fd });
      const raw = await res.text();
      let j: any = {};
      try { j = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { /* not json */ }
      if (res.status === 413) throw new Error("Image is too large. Use one under 2MB.");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(j.error || `Prepare failed (${res.status})`);
      ticket = j.ticket;
      mint = j.mint;

      setStage("sign");
      const flags = (j.versioned as boolean[]) ?? [];
      const txs = (j.transactions as string[]).map((b, n) =>
        flags[n] ? VersionedTransaction.deserialize(Buffer.from(b, "base64")) : Transaction.from(Buffer.from(b, "base64")),
      );
      const signed = await signAllTransactions(txs as Transaction[]);
      // Mint signs after the wallet so the wallet cannot invalidate it.
      const mintKp = Keypair.fromSecretKey(Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(j.mintSecret as string, "base64")));
      const first = signed[0] as Transaction | VersionedTransaction;
      if (first instanceof VersionedTransaction) first.sign([mintKp]);
      else first.partialSign(mintKp);

      setStage("create");
      const firstSig = await sendAndConfirm(signed[0], j.lastValidBlockHeights[0]);
      created = true;

      setStage("lock");
      // The lock transaction was signed before the coin was created. If the first step took long and its
      // blockhash is about to expire, ask for a fresh one instead of sending a transaction that will fail.
      let nearExpiry = false;
      try {

      } catch { /* best effort */ }

      } else {

    } finally {
      setStage("idle");
    }

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ActivityEvent } from "@/lib/data";
import { fmtSol, timeAgo } from "@/lib/format";
import Icon from "./Icon";
import Counter from "./Counter";

type Payload = {
  stats: { coins: number; lamports: number; charities: number };
  activity: ActivityEvent[];
  generatedAt: number;
};

const BASE_MS = 8000;

// Live feed without websockets. Everyone polls one CDN cached endpoint, so load on our servers
// stays flat no matter how many people watch. Polling pauses when the tab is hidden, adds jitter so
// clients do not sync up, and backs off after errors while keeping the last good data on screen.
export default function LiveFeed({ initial, showStats = false }: { initial: Payload; showStats?: boolean }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Payload>(initial);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const seen = useRef(new Set(initial.activity.map((e) => e.id)));
  const fresh = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const fails = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    let stopped = false;
    let ctl: AbortController | null = null;

    const schedule = (ms: number) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      timer = setTimeout(tick, ms * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3));
    };

    const tick = async () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      if (document.hidden) return schedule(BASE_MS);
      ctl = new AbortController();
      try {
        const r = await fetch("/api/activity", { signal: ctl.signal, cache: "no-store" });
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status));
        const p = (await r.json()) as Payload;
        const newIds = p.activity.filter((e) => !seen.current.has(e.id)).map((e) => e.id);
        newIds.forEach((id) => {
          seen.current.add(id);
          fresh.current.add(id);
        });
        fails.current = 0;
        setData(p);
        setNow(Date.now());
        schedule(BASE_MS);
      } catch {
        fails.current = Math.min(fails.current + 1, 5);
        schedule(Math.min(60_000, BASE_MS * 2 ** fails.current));
      }
    };

    const onVis = () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        schedule(300);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    schedule(BASE_MS);
    const clock = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 15_000);
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      clearInterval(clock);
      ctl?.abort();
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    };
  }, []);

  const items = data.activity.slice(0, 10);

  return (
    <div>
      {showStats && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-baseline gap-2 text-sm text-mute">
          <span className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-cream">
            <Counter value={data.stats.lamports / 1e9} decimals={2} />
          </span>
          SOL donated on chain
        </div>
      )}
      <ul className="space-y-2" aria-live="polite">
        {items.length === 0 && <li className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-mute">Waiting for the first launch.</li>}
        {items.map((e) => (
          <li key={e.id} className={fresh.current.has(e.id) ? "animate-slideIn" : ""}>
            <Link
              href={`/coin/${e.mint}`}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-raise/60 px-3.5 py-3 transition hover:border-ember/40"
            >
              <span
                className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
                  e.type === "donation" ? "bg-rose/15 text-rose" : "bg-amber/15 text-amber"
                }`}
              >
                <Icon name={e.type === "donation" ? "heart" : "zap"} size={15} />
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-snug">
                {e.type === "donation" ? (
                  <>
                    <b className="font-semibold">{e.name}</b> sent <b className="text-amber">{fmtSol(e.lamports ?? 0)} SOL</b>
                    <span className="text-mute"> to {e.charityName}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <b className="font-semibold">{e.name}</b> <span className="text-mute">launched for {e.charityName}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </span>
              <span className="shrink-0 text-xs text-faint" suppressHydrationWarning>{timeAgo(e.at, now)}</span>
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createChart, type IChartApi, type ISeriesApi, type UTCTimestamp } from "lightweight-charts";
import { toCandles, TOTAL_SUPPLY, type Trade } from "@/lib/candles";

// Our own chart. Trades are read from the chain by /api/candles, so a brand new coin charts from its first trade.
// Y axis is market cap in SOL (price times the 1 billion supply every pump.fun coin has).
const TFS = [
  { k: "1s", s: 1 },
  { k: "5s", s: 5 },
  { k: "15s", s: 15 },
  { k: "30s", s: 30 },
  { k: "1m", s: 60 },
  { k: "5m", s: 300 },
  { k: "15m", s: 900 },
  { k: "1h", s: 3600 },
];

const UP = "#34d399";
const DOWN = "#fb7185";

function fmt(n: number) {
  if (n >= 1000) return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  if (n >= 1) return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 });
}

export default function PriceChart({ mint, symbol }: { mint: string; symbol: string }) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chart = useRef<IChartApi | null>(null);
  const candleS = useRef<ISeriesApi<"Candlestick"> | null>(null);
  const volS = useRef<ISeriesApi<"Histogram"> | null>(null);
  const [tf, setTf] = useState(TFS[5]);
  const [trades, setTrades] = useState<Trade[] | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const pump = `https://pump.fun/coin/${mint}`;

  // Remember the chosen timeframe for the next chart, in this browser.
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = TFS.find((t) => t.k === localStorage.getItem("givefun:tf"));
      if (saved) setTf(saved);
    } catch {
      /* storage blocked, keep the default */
    }
  }, []);
  function pickTf(t: (typeof TFS)[number]) {
    setTf(t);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("givefun:tf", t.k);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  // create the chart once
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!box.current) return;
    const c = createChart(box.current, {
      autoSize: true,
      layout: { background: { color: "transparent" }, textColor: "#9aa3b2", fontFamily: "inherit" },
      grid: { vertLines: { color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" }, horzLines: { color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" } },
      rightPriceScale: { borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)", scaleMargins: { top: 0.08, bottom: 0.25 } },
      timeScale: { borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)", timeVisible: true, secondsVisible: false },
      crosshair: { mode: 0 },
    });
    candleS.current = c.addCandlestickSeries({
      upColor: UP,
      downColor: DOWN,
      wickUpColor: UP,
      wickDownColor: DOWN,
      borderVisible: false,
      priceFormat: { type: "custom", formatter: (p: number) => fmt(p) },
    });
    volS.current = c.addHistogramSeries({ priceFormat: { type: "volume" }, priceScaleId: "vol" });
    c.priceScale("vol").applyOptions({ scaleMargins: { top: 0.8, bottom: 0 } });
    chart.current = c;
    return () => {
      c.remove();
      chart.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  // poll trades
  useEffect(() => {
    let stop = false;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    async function load() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`/api/candles/${mint}`, { cache: "no-store" });
        const j = (await r.json()) as { trades?: Trade[] };
        if (!stop && Array.isArray(j.trades)) {
          setTrades(j.trades);
          setFailed(false);
        }
      } catch {
        if (!stop) setFailed(true);
      }
      if (!stop) timer = setTimeout(load, document.hidden ? 60_000 : 10_000);
    }
    load();
    return () => {
      stop = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [mint]);

  // draw
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trades || !candleS.current || !volS.current) return;
    const scaled: Trade[] = trades.map((t) => [t[0], t[1] * TOTAL_SUPPLY, t[2], t[3]]);
    const { candles, volume } = toCandles(scaled, tf.s);
    candleS.current.setData(candles.map((c) => ({ ...c, time: c.time as UTCTimestamp })));
    volS.current.setData(volume.map((v) => ({ time: v.time as UTCTimestamp, value: v.value, color: v.up ? "rgba(52,211,153,0.35)" : "rgba(251,113,133,0.35)" })));
    chart.current?.applyOptions({ timeScale: { secondsVisible: tf.s < 60 } });
    chart.current?.timeScale().fitContent();
  }, [trades, tf]);

  const last = trades && trades.length ? trades[trades.length - 1][1] * TOTAL_SUPPLY : null;
  const empty = trades !== null && trades.length === 0;

  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 sm:px-6">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold">${symbol} chart</h2>
          <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-mute">
            Market cap {last !== null ? <b className="text-white">{fmt(last)} SOL</b> : "loading"}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-line text-xs">
            {TFS.map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.k}
                onClick={() => pickTf(t)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold ${tf.k === t.k ? "bg-raise text-white" : "text-mute hover:text-white"}`}
              >
                {t.k}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <a href={pump} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="btn btn-sm">Buy</a>
          <a href={pump} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="btn-ghost btn-sm">Sell</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="relative h-[480px] w-full border-t border-line bg-ink">
        <div ref={box} className="absolute inset-0" />
        {(trades === null || empty || failed) && (
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-mute">
            {failed && trades === null ? "Could not load the chart. Retrying." : empty ? "No trades yet. The chart starts with the first trade." : "Loading chart"}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="border-t border-line px-6 py-3 text-xs text-mute">
        Live from the chain, updates every few seconds. Market cap in SOL. Trading happens on pump.fun.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

// Fades children up when they scroll into view. Content is visible without JS thanks to the noscript style in the layout.
export default function Reveal({
  children,
  delay = 0,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  delay?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      el.classList.add("in");
      return;
    }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (es) => {
        for (const e of es) {
          if (e.isIntersecting) {
            e.target.classList.add("in");
            io.unobserve(e.target);
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px" },
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`reveal ${className}`} style={{ transitionDelay: `${delay}ms` }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export type Seg = { label: string; bps: number; color: string };

export const SEG = { charity: "#ff6a45", platform: "#ffc766", dev: "#4b443c" };

export function segsFor(charityBps: number, platformBps: number): Seg[] {
  const dev = Math.max(0, 10000 - charityBps - platformBps);
  const out: Seg[] = [{ label: "Charity", bps: charityBps, color: SEG.charity }];
  if (platformBps > 0) out.push({ label: "Platform", bps: platformBps, color: SEG.platform });
  if (dev > 0) out.push({ label: "Dev", bps: dev, color: SEG.dev });
  return out;
}

export default function SplitBar({ segs, legend = false, height = 8 }: { segs: Seg[]; legend?: boolean; height?: number }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-line" style={{ height }} role="img" aria-label={segs.map((s) => `${s.label} ${s.bps / 100}%`).join(", ")}>
        {segs.map((s) => (
          <div key={s.label} style={{ width: `${s.bps / 100}%`, background: s.color }} className="transition-[width] duration-500" />
        ))}
      </div>
      {legend && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-mute">
          {segs.map((s) => (

export async function adminPost<T = unknown>(url: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const r = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: string }).error || `Request failed (${r.status})`);
  return j as T;
}
export async function adminGet<T = unknown>(url: string): Promise<T> {
  const r = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: string }).error || `Request failed (${r.status})`);
  return j as T;
}

      setBusy("");

/**
 * Circuit breaker. After `threshold` consecutive failures the breaker opens and
 * rejects instantly for `cooldownMs`, so a struggling dependency (the database)
 * is not hammered while it recovers. After the cooldown one trial call is allowed.
 */
export class Breaker {
  private fails = 0;
  private openedAt = 0;
  private trial = false;

  constructor(
    public readonly name: string,
    private readonly threshold = 5,
    private readonly cooldownMs = 20_000,
  ) {}

  get isOpen(): boolean {
    return this.fails >= this.threshold && Date.now() - this.openedAt < this.cooldownMs;
  }

  async run<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (this.fails >= this.threshold) {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - this.openedAt;
      if (elapsed < this.cooldownMs) throw new Error(`breaker ${this.name} open`);
      if (this.trial) throw new Error(`breaker ${this.name} half open`);
      this.trial = true;
    }
    try {
      const r = await fn();
      this.fails = 0;
      this.trial = false;
      return r;
    } catch (e) {
      this.fails++;
      this.trial = false;
      if (this.fails >= this.threshold) this.openedAt = Date.now();
      throw e;
    }
  }

  state() {
    return {
      name: this.name,
      open: this.isOpen,
      consecutiveFailures: this.fails,
      retryInMs: this.isOpen ? Math.max(0, this.cooldownMs - (Date.now() - this.openedAt)) : 0,
    };
  }

  reset() {
    this.fails = 0;
    this.trial = false;
    this.openedAt = 0;
  }
}

export const dbBreaker = new Breaker("db", 5, 20_000);

// Pure and browser safe. Shared by the server (types) and the chart component (aggregation).

/** [unixSeconds, priceSol, solAmount, isBuy 1/0]. Price is SOL per whole token. */
export type Trade = [number, number, number, number];

export const TOTAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000;

export type Candle = { time: number; open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number };
export type Bar = { time: number; value: number; up: boolean };

/** Groups trades into candles. Each candle opens at the previous close, like a trading terminal. */
export function toCandles(trades: Trade[], tfSec: number): { candles: Candle[]; volume: Bar[] } {
  const candles: Candle[] = [];
  const vols: number[] = [];
  let prevClose: number | null = null;
  for (const [t, price, sol] of trades) {
    const bucket = Math.floor(t / tfSec) * tfSec;
    const last = candles[candles.length - 1];
    if (last && last.time === bucket) {
      last.high = Math.max(last.high, price);
      last.low = Math.min(last.low, price);
      last.close = price;
      vols[vols.length - 1] += sol;
    } else {
      const open: number = prevClose ?? price;
      candles.push({ time: bucket, open, high: Math.max(open, price), low: Math.min(open, price), close: price });
      vols.push(sol);
    }
    prevClose = price;
  }
  const volume = candles.map((c, i) => ({ time: c.time, value: vols[i], up: c.close >= c.open }));
  return { candles, volume };
}

import type { Connection } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { sleep } from "./util";

/**
 * Confirms a transaction by polling over plain HTTP.
 * web3.js confirmTransaction opens a websocket, which our RPC proxy and serverless hosts do not support.
 */
export async function confirmByPolling(
  conn: Connection,
  signature: string,
  lastValidBlockHeight: number,
  timeoutMs = 90_000,
  /** Called every few seconds while waiting. Resending the same signed bytes is safe and gets a dropped transaction through. */
  rebroadcast?: () => Promise<unknown>,
): Promise<void> {
  const start = Date.now();
  let loop = 0;
  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
    const { value } = await conn.getSignatureStatuses([signature], { searchTransactionHistory: false });
    const st = value[0];
    if (st) {
      if (st.err) throw new Error("Transaction failed on chain");
      if (st.confirmationStatus === "confirmed" || st.confirmationStatus === "finalized") return;
    }
    if (loop % 3 === 2) {
      const bh = await conn.getBlockHeight("confirmed");
      if (bh > lastValidBlockHeight) throw new Error("Transaction expired, please try again");
    }
    if (rebroadcast && loop % 2 === 1) await rebroadcast().catch(() => undefined);
    loop++;
    await sleep(1500);
  }
  throw new Error("Confirmation timed out");
}

export async function loadHome(): Promise<HomeData> {
  const s = store();
  if (isDemo()) await s.demoTick?.();

  const [charities, latest, top, payouts] = await Promise.all([
    loadCharitiesFresh(),
    s.listCoins({ limit: 24, order: "new" }),
    s.listCoins({ limit: 6, order: "donated" }),
    s.recentPayouts(20),
  ]);

  const byslug = new Map(charities.map((c) => [c.slug, c]));
  const name = (slug: string) => byslug.get(slug)?.name ?? slug;

  const events: ActivityEvent[] = [
    ...latest.slice(0, 15).map((c): ActivityEvent => ({
      id: `l:${c.mint}`,
      type: "launch",
      at: c.verified_at ?? c.created_at,
      mint: c.mint,
      name: c.name,
      symbol: c.symbol,
      charitySlug: c.charity_slug,
      charityName: name(c.charity_slug),
    })),
    ...payouts.map((p): ActivityEvent => ({
      id: `p:${p.signature}`,
      type: "donation",
      at: p.created_at,
      mint: p.mint,
      name: p.coin_name,
      symbol: p.coin_symbol,
      charitySlug: p.charity_slug,
      charityName: name(p.charity_slug),
      lamports: p.lamports,
      signature: p.signature,
    })),
  ]
    .sort((a, b) => b.at.localeCompare(a.at))
    .slice(0, 30);

  const live = charities.filter((c) => c.verified && c.active);
  const stats = {
    coins: charities.reduce((a, c) => a + c.coins, 0),
    lamports: charities.reduce((a, c) => a + c.lamports, 0),
    charities: live.length,
  };

  const topCharities = [...live].sort((a, b) => b.lamports - a.lamports).slice(0, 6);
  return { stats, latest, top, topCharities, activity: events, generatedAt: Date.now() };
}

  });

export const LAMPORTS = 1_000_000_000;

export function solFromLamports(l: number | string | bigint): number {
  return Number(l) / LAMPORTS;
}

export function fmtSol(l: number | string | bigint, max = 3): string {
  const n = solFromLamports(l);
  if (n === 0) return "0";
  if (n < 0.001) return "<0.001";
  return n.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: max });
}

export function timeAgo(iso: string | number, now = Date.now()): string {
  const t = typeof iso === "number" ? iso : new Date(iso).getTime();
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - t) / 1000));
  if (s < 10) return "just now";
  if (s < 60) return `${s}s ago`;
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return `${m}m ago`;
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
  return `${d}d ago`;
}

export const shortAddr = (a: string, n = 4) => (a.length > n * 2 + 3 ? `${a.slice(0, n)}...${a.slice(-n)}` : a);

// Deterministic warm gradient per mint, so every coin without an image still has a face.
export function gradientFor(seed: string): [string, string] {
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  const hues = [8, 18, 28, 40, 48, 150, 165, 340, 352];
  const a = hues[h % hues.length];
  const b = hues[(h >> 5) % hues.length];
  return [`hsl(${a} 90% 62%)`, `hsl(${(b + 30) % 360} 85% 48%)`];
}

import { Redis } from "@upstash/redis";
import { withTimeout } from "./util";

/**
 * Key value layer. Uses Upstash Redis when configured, an in process Map otherwise.
 * Every Redis call has a hard timeout and falls back to the Map on any failure,
 * so a Redis outage degrades the site (per instance caching) instead of crashing it.
 */

type MemEntry = { v: unknown; exp: number };
const mem = new Map<string, MemEntry>();
const MEM_MAX = 5000;

const url = () => process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL || process.env.KV_REST_API_URL || "";
const token = () => process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN || process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN || "";

let client: Redis | null | undefined;
function redis(): Redis | null {
  if (client !== undefined) return client;
  if (!url() || !token()) {
    client = null;
    return client;
  }
  client = new Redis({ url: url(), token: token(), retry: { retries: 1, backoff: () => 80 } });
  return client;
}

export const kvStatus = {
  kind: "memory" as "redis" | "memory",
  failures: 0,
  consecutiveFailures: 0,
  lastError: "",
  lastOkAt: 0,
};

function refreshKind() {
  kvStatus.kind = redis() ? "redis" : "memory";
}

const REDIS_TIMEOUT_MS = 900;

async function viaRedis<T>(label: string, fn: (r: Redis) => Promise<T>): Promise<{ ok: true; v: T } | { ok: false }> {
  const r = redis();
  refreshKind();
  if (!r) return { ok: false };
  // Skip Redis briefly after repeated failures so a dead Redis costs no latency.
  if (kvStatus.consecutiveFailures >= 4 && Date.now() - kvStatus.lastOkAt < 15_000) return { ok: false };
  try {
    const v = await withTimeout(fn(r), REDIS_TIMEOUT_MS, `redis ${label}`);
    kvStatus.consecutiveFailures = 0;
    kvStatus.lastOkAt = Date.now();
    return { ok: true, v };
  } catch (e) {
    kvStatus.failures++;
    kvStatus.consecutiveFailures++;
    kvStatus.lastError = (e as Error).message;
    if (kvStatus.consecutiveFailures === 4) kvStatus.lastOkAt = Date.now();
    return { ok: false };
  }
}

function memSweep() {
  if (mem.size <= MEM_MAX) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [k, e] of mem) if (e.exp <= now) mem.delete(k);
  if (mem.size > MEM_MAX) {
    // Still too big: drop oldest inserted entries.
    let n = mem.size - MEM_MAX;
    for (const k of mem.keys()) {
      mem.delete(k);
      if (--n <= 0) break;
    }
  }
}

function memGet<T>(key: string): T | null {
  const e = mem.get(key);
  if (!e) return null;
  if (e.exp <= Date.now()) {
    mem.delete(key);
    return null;
  }
  return e.v as T;
}

function memSet(key: string, v: unknown, ttlSec: number) {
  mem.set(key, { v, exp: Date.now() + ttlSec * 1000 });
  memSweep();
}

export async function kvGet<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  const r = await viaRedis("get", (c) => c.get<T>(key));
  if (r.ok) return (r.v as T | null) ?? null;
  return memGet<T>(key);
}

export async function kvSet(key: string, value: unknown, ttlSec: number): Promise<void> {
  // Always keep a local copy too, it is the safety net if Redis drops.
  memSet(key, value, Math.min(ttlSec, 3600));
  await viaRedis("set", (c) => c.set(key, value as never, { ex: ttlSec }));
}

export async function kvDel(key: string): Promise<void> {
  mem.delete(key);
  await viaRedis("del", (c) => c.del(key));
}

/** Set only if absent. Returns true if this caller won the lock. */
export async function kvLock(key: string, ttlSec: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const r = await viaRedis("lock", (c) => c.set(key, "1", { nx: true, ex: ttlSec }));
  if (r.ok) return r.v === "OK";
  if (memGet(key)) return false;
  memSet(key, "1", ttlSec);
  return true;
}

const INCR_SCRIPT =
  "local n=redis.call('INCR',KEYS[1]) if n==1 then redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],ARGV[1]) end return n";

/** Atomic counter with expiry set on first increment. */
export async function kvIncr(key: string, ttlSec: number): Promise<number> {
  const r = await viaRedis("incr", (c) => c.eval<[string], number>(INCR_SCRIPT, [key], [String(ttlSec)]));
  if (r.ok) return Number(r.v);
  const cur = memGet<number>(key) ?? 0;
  const exp = mem.get(key)?.exp;
  const next = cur + 1;
  mem.set(key, { v: next, exp: exp && exp > Date.now() ? exp : Date.now() + ttlSec * 1000 });
  return next;
}

export async function kvPing(): Promise<{ kind: "redis" | "memory"; ok: boolean; ms: number }> {
  refreshKind();
  const t0 = Date.now();
  if (!redis()) return { kind: "memory", ok: true, ms: 0 };
  const r = await viaRedis("ping", (c) => c.ping());
  return { kind: "redis", ok: r.ok, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
}

  kvStatus.failures = 0;
  kvStatus.consecutiveFailures = 0;
  kvStatus.lastError = "";
}

import { AddressLookupTableAccount, Connection, PublicKey, TransactionInstruction } from "@solana/web3.js";
import type { Global } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";

/**
 * A launch with a dev buy does not fit in one legacy transaction (1232 byte limit).
 * An address lookup table stores the accounts that are the same on every launch, so the transaction only
 * references them by a one byte index. The table is created once with scripts/create-lut.ts.
 */

export class LutMissingError extends Error {
  constructor(msg = "Dev buy is not set up yet") {
    super(msg);
  }
}

/** Accounts that appear in every sample launch, plus every fee recipient the program may pick. */
export function staticKeys(global: Global, samples: TransactionInstruction[][]): PublicKey[] {
  const sets = samples.map(
    (ixs) => new Set(ixs.flatMap((ix) => [ix.programId.toBase58(), ...ix.keys.map((k) => k.pubkey.toBase58())])),
  );
  const common = [...sets[0]].filter((k) => sets.every((s) => s.has(k)));
  const extra = [
    global.feeRecipient,
    ...global.feeRecipients,
    global.reservedFeeRecipient,
    ...global.reservedFeeRecipients,
    ...global.buybackFeeRecipients,
  ].map((k) => k.toBase58());
  return [...new Set([...common, ...extra])]
    .filter((k) => k !== PublicKey.default.toBase58())
    .map((k) => new PublicKey(k));
}

let cache: { at: number; table: AddressLookupTableAccount } | null = null;

export async function loadLaunchTable(connection: Connection): Promise<AddressLookupTableAccount> {
  const addr = (process.env.LAUNCH_LUT || "").trim();
  if (!addr) throw new LutMissingError();
  if (cache && Date.now() - cache.at < 5 * 60_000) return cache.table;
  const { value } = await connection.getAddressLookupTable(new PublicKey(addr));
  if (!value || value.state.addresses.length === 0) throw new LutMissingError("Dev buy table not found on chain");
  cache = { at: Date.now(), table: value };
  return value;
}

// Token metadata upload. Two routes, tried in order:
//   1. Pinata (set PINATA_JWT). Reliable from servers. Free plan is enough.
//   2. pump.fun's IPFS endpoint (METADATA_UPLOAD_URL, default https://pump.fun/api/ipfs). Undocumented and
//      sometimes blocks server traffic, so it is the fallback.
// Returns the metadata URI that goes on chain and the image URL we store.

export type MetaInput = { file: File; name: string; symbol: string; description: string; website?: string; twitter?: string; telegram?: string };
export type MetaResult = { uri: string; imageUrl: string | null; via: "pinata" | "pump" };

const TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
const gateway = () => (process.env.IPFS_GATEWAY || "https://ipfs.io/ipfs").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const pinataBase = () => (process.env.PINATA_API_URL || "https://api.pinata.cloud").replace(/\/+$/, "");

export class MetaError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public detail: string) {
    super(message);
  }
}

async function viaPinata(i: MetaInput): Promise<MetaResult> {
  const jwt = process.env.PINATA_JWT!;
  const auth = { Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` };

  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("file", i.file, i.file.name || "image");
  fd.append("pinataMetadata", JSON.stringify({ name: `${i.symbol}-image` }));
  const r1 = await fetch(`${pinataBase()}/pinning/pinFileToIPFS`, { method: "POST", headers: auth, body: fd, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS) });
  if (!r1.ok) throw new Error(`pinata image ${r1.status}`);
  const imgCid = ((await r1.json()) as { IpfsHash?: string }).IpfsHash;
  if (!imgCid) throw new Error("pinata image: no hash");
  const imageUrl = `${gateway()}/${imgCid}`;

  const json = { name: i.name, symbol: i.symbol, description: i.description, image: imageUrl, showName: true, createdOn: "https://pump.fun", ...(i.website ? { website: i.website } : {}), ...(i.twitter ? { twitter: i.twitter } : {}), ...(i.telegram ? { telegram: i.telegram } : {}) };
  const r2 = await fetch(`${pinataBase()}/pinning/pinJSONToIPFS`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { ...auth, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ pinataContent: json, pinataMetadata: { name: `${i.symbol}-metadata` } }),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
  });
  if (!r2.ok) throw new Error(`pinata json ${r2.status}`);
  const cid = ((await r2.json()) as { IpfsHash?: string }).IpfsHash;
  if (!cid) throw new Error("pinata json: no hash");
  return { uri: `${gateway()}/${cid}`, imageUrl, via: "pinata" };
}

async function viaPump(i: MetaInput): Promise<MetaResult> {
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("file", i.file, i.file.name || "image");
  fd.append("name", i.name);
  fd.append("symbol", i.symbol);
  fd.append("description", i.description);
  fd.append("showName", "true");
  if (i.website) fd.append("website", i.website);
  if (i.twitter) fd.append("twitter", i.twitter);
  if (i.telegram) fd.append("telegram", i.telegram);
  const res = await fetch(process.env.METADATA_UPLOAD_URL || "https://pump.fun/api/ipfs", {
    method: "POST",
    body: fd,
    headers: { Origin: "https://pump.fun", Referer: "https://pump.fun/create", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; GiveFun/1.0)" },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`pump ${res.status}`);
  const j = (await res.json()) as { metadataUri?: string; metadata?: { image?: string } };
  if (!j.metadataUri) throw new Error("pump: no metadataUri");
  return { uri: j.metadataUri, imageUrl: j.metadata?.image ?? null, via: "pump" };
}

export async function uploadMetadata(i: MetaInput): Promise<MetaResult> {
  const routes: (() => Promise<MetaResult>)[] = [];
  if (process.env.PINATA_JWT) routes.push(() => viaPinata(i));
  routes.push(() => viaPump(i));

  const errors: string[] = [];
  for (const run of routes) {
    try {
      return await run();
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push((e as Error).message.slice(0, 80));
    }
  }
  console.error("metadata upload failed:", errors.join(" | "));
  throw new MetaError("Could not upload metadata. Try again.", errors.join(" | "));
}
