import { MIN_CHARITY_BPS } from "./config";

export class TooLargeError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super("Name, ticker or links are too long to include a dev buy");
  }
}

export type LaunchIxInput = {
  creator: PublicKey;
  mint: PublicKey;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  uri: string;
  shares: Share[];
  /** Optional dev buy. Runs in the same transaction as create, so nobody can snipe the coin first. */
  devBuy?: { global: Global; amount: BN; solAmount: BN };
};

/**
 * Offline. Returns instruction groups for the launch:
 *  1) create_v2
 *  2) create_fee_sharing_config + update_fee_shares_v2 (locks the split, admin revoked)
 * The split is set before anyone can trade, so no fees can accrue under dev control.
 */
export async function buildLaunchInstructions(i: LaunchIxInput): Promise<{
  create: TransactionInstruction[];
  share: TransactionInstruction[];
}> {
  // With a dev buy: create_v2 + the creator's token account + the first buy, all in one transaction.
  const createIxs = i.devBuy
    ? await PUMP_SDK.createV2AndBuyInstructions({
        global: i.devBuy.global,
        mint: i.mint,
        name: i.name,
        symbol: i.symbol,
        uri: i.uri,
        creator: i.creator,
        user: i.creator,
        amount: i.devBuy.amount,
        solAmount: i.devBuy.solAmount,
        mayhemMode: false,
      })
    : [
        await PUMP_SDK.createV2Instruction({
          mint: i.mint,
          name: i.name,
          symbol: i.symbol,
          uri: i.uri,
          creator: i.creator,
          user: i.creator,
          mayhemMode: false,
        }),
      ];

  // Any trade before the split exists (including the dev buy) leaves creator fees on the curve.
  // pump.fun refuses the creator change (error 6095) until they are swept, so sweep first, same transaction.
  // It is permissionless and harmless when there is nothing to sweep.
  const sweepIx = await PUMP_SDK.sweepCreatorFeeInstruction({
    payer: i.creator,
    mint: i.mint,
    creator: i.creator,
    quoteMint: NATIVE_MINT,
    quoteTokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
  });

  const cfgIx = await PUMP_SDK.createFeeSharingConfig({
    creator: i.creator,
    mint: i.mint,
    pool: null,
  });

  const updIx = await PUMP_SDK.updateFeeSharesV2({
    authority: i.creator,
    mint: i.mint,
    currentShareholders: [i.creator],
    newShareholders: i.shares,
    quoteMint: NATIVE_MINT,
    quoteTokenProgram: TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID,
    bondingCurveComplete: false,
  });

  return {
    // With a dev buy the transaction is close to the size limit, so the compute limit instruction is dropped
    // (the default limit is enough). The priority fee stays so the transaction lands.
    create: [
      ...(i.devBuy ? [] : [ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitLimit({ units: 300_000 })]),
      ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitPrice({ microLamports: 200_000 }),
      ...createIxs,
    ],
    share: [ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitLimit({ units: 300_000 }), ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitPrice({ microLamports: 200_000 }), sweepIx, cfgIx, updIx],
  };
}

/**
 * Online. Builds unsigned transactions for the dev wallet to sign.
 * The mint keypair partial signs the first transaction. We never hold the dev key or any funds.
 */
export async function buildLaunchTransactions(
  connection: Connection,
  i: LaunchIxInput,
  mintKeypair: Keypair,
  devBuyLamports?: bigint,
): Promise<{ txs: (Transaction | VersionedTransaction)[]; lastValidBlockHeight: number }> {
  const withBuy = Boolean(devBuyLamports && devBuyLamports > 0n);
  let input = i;
  let table = null as Awaited<ReturnType<typeof loadLaunchTable>> | null;
  if (withBuy) {
    table = await loadLaunchTable(connection); // throws LutMissingError when dev buy is not set up
    const sdk = new OnlinePumpSdk(connection);
    const [global, feeConfig] = await Promise.all([sdk.fetchGlobal(), sdk.fetchFeeConfig()]);
    const solAmount = new BN((devBuyLamports as bigint).toString());
    // A coin that does not exist yet: quote from the starting curve.
    const amount = getBuyTokenAmountFromSolAmount({
      global,
      feeConfig,
      mintSupply: null,
      bondingCurve: null,
      amount: solAmount,
      quoteMint: NATIVE_MINT,
    });
    if (amount.lten(0)) throw new Error("Dev buy amount is too small");
    input = { ...i, devBuy: { global, amount, solAmount } };
  }
  const { create, share } = await buildLaunchInstructions(input);
  const { blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } = await connection.getLatestBlockhash("confirmed");

  // The mint signs on the client AFTER the wallet. Wallets such as Phantom may rewrite the
  // message when signing, which would wipe a signature added earlier.
  void mintKeypair;

  let tx1: Transaction | VersionedTransaction;
  if (withBuy && table) {
    // Create + dev buy in ONE transaction, so nobody can snipe the coin before the creator buys.
    const msg = new TransactionMessage({ payerKey: i.creator, recentBlockhash: blockhash, instructions: create }).compileToV0Message([table]);
    const v = new VersionedTransaction(msg);
    if (v.serialize().length > 1232) throw new TooLargeError();
    tx1 = v;
  } else {
    const t = new Transaction({ feePayer: i.creator, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight });
    t.add(...create);
    tx1 = t;
  }
  const tx2 = new Transaction({ feePayer: i.creator, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight });
  tx2.add(...share);
  return { txs: [tx1, tx2], lastValidBlockHeight };
}

export type VerifyResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  reasons: string[];
  locked: boolean;
  shareholders: { address: string; shareBps: number }[];
  admin: string | null;
};

/**
 * Reads pump.fun accounts on chain and checks the charity split is real and locked.
 * Chain is the source of truth. Nothing from our DB or the client is trusted.
 */
export async function verifyOnChain(
  connection: Connection,
  mint: PublicKey,
  charityWallet: string,
  minBps = MIN_CHARITY_BPS,
): Promise<VerifyResult> {
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  const cfgAddr = feeSharingConfigPda(mint);
  const info = await connection.getAccountInfo(cfgAddr, "confirmed");
  if (!info) {
    return { ok: false, reasons: ["No sharing config on chain"], locked: false, shareholders: [], admin: null };
  }

  const cfg = PUMP_SDK.decodeSharingConfig(info);
  const shareholders = cfg.shareholders.map((s) => ({
    address: s.address.toBase58(),
    shareBps: s.shareBps,
  }));

  const locked = cfg.adminRevoked === true;
  if (!locked) reasons.push("Split is not locked (admin not revoked)");

  const entry = shareholders.find((s) => s.address === charityWallet);
  if (!entry) reasons.push("Charity wallet is not a shareholder");
  else if (entry.shareBps < minBps) reasons.push(`Charity share below ${minBps / 100}%`);

  // Creator vault must route through the sharing config, else fees bypass the split.
  try {
    const bc = await new OnlinePumpSdk(connection).fetchBondingCurve(mint);
    if (!bc.creator.equals(cfgAddr)) reasons.push("Bonding curve creator is not the sharing config");
  } catch {
    // Graduated coins may not have a readable curve here. Do not fail on that alone.
  }

  return { ok: reasons.length === 0, reasons, locked, shareholders, admin: cfg.admin.toBase58() };
}

export { bondingCurvePda, feeSharingConfigPda };

import { kvIncr } from "./kv";
import { ipOf } from "./util";

export type LimitResult = { ok: boolean; remaining: number; resetSec: number };

/** Fixed window limiter shared across instances through Redis. Falls back to per instance memory. */
export async function limit(key: string, max: number, windowSec: number): Promise<LimitResult> {
  const bucket = Math.floor(Date.now() / (windowSec * 1000));
  const n = await kvIncr(`rl:${key}:${bucket}`, windowSec + 1);
  const resetSec = windowSec - Math.floor((Date.now() / 1000) % windowSec);
  return { ok: n <= max, remaining: Math.max(0, max - n), resetSec };
}

/** Route helper. Returns a 429 Response when over the limit, otherwise null. */
export async function guard(req: Request, name: string, max: number, windowSec: number): Promise<Response | null> {
  const r = await limit(`${name}:${ipOf(req)}`, max, windowSec);
  if (r.ok) return null;
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Too many requests" }), {
    status: 429,
    headers: {
      "content-type": "application/json",
      "cache-control": "no-store",
      "retry-after": String(r.resetSec),
    },
  });
}

import { Connection } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { maskUrl, sleep } from "./util";

/**
 * RPC pool with automatic failover.
 * Endpoints come from HELIUS_RPC_URL (primary), then RPC_URLS (comma separated, any provider),
 * then the public endpoint as a last resort. Add a second or third free tier key and the app
 * survives any single provider rate limiting or going down, with no extra cost.
 */

const PUBLIC_RPC = "https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com";
const ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

type EpState = { url: string; cooldownUntil: number; fails: number; lastError: string; lastMs: number; calls: number };

let eps: EpState[] | null = null;

export function rpcEndpoints(): string[] {
  const list: string[] = [];
  if (process.env.HELIUS_RPC_URL) list.push(process.env.HELIUS_RPC_URL.trim());
  for (const u of (process.env.RPC_URLS ?? "").split(",")) if (u.trim()) list.push(u.trim());
  list.push(PUBLIC_RPC);
  return Array.from(new Set(list));
}

function pool(): EpState[] {
  if (!eps) {
    eps = rpcEndpoints().map((url) => ({ url, cooldownUntil: 0, fails: 0, lastError: "", lastMs: 0, calls: 0 }));
  }
  return eps;
}

function pick(skip: Set<string>): EpState | null {
  const now = Date.now();
  const p = pool().filter((e) => !skip.has(e.url));
  if (p.length === 0) return null;
  const healthy = p.find((e) => e.cooldownUntil <= now);
  if (healthy) return healthy;
  return p.slice().sort((a, b) => a.cooldownUntil - b.cooldownUntil)[0];
}

export async function failoverFetch(_input: unknown, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {
  const tried = new Set<string>();
  let lastRes: Response | null = null;
  let lastErr: unknown = null;
  const maxAttempts = Math.max(2, Math.min(4, pool().length));

  for (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {
    const ep = pick(tried);
    if (!ep) break;
    tried.add(ep.url);
    const t0 = Date.now();
    ep.calls++;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(ep.url, { ...init, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS) });
      ep.lastMs = Date.now() - t0;
      if (res.status === 429 || res.status >= 500) {
        ep.fails++;
        ep.lastError = `http ${res.status}`;
        ep.cooldownUntil = Date.now() + (res.status === 429 ? 20_000 : 10_000);
        lastRes = res;
        continue;
      }
      ep.fails = 0;
      ep.lastError = "";
      return res;
    } catch (e) {
      ep.fails++;
      ep.lastError = (e as Error).message.slice(0, 120);
      ep.cooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10_000;
      lastErr = e;
    }
    // Only one endpoint configured: brief backoff then retry it.
    if (pool().length === 1) {
      tried.clear();
      await sleep(250 * (i + 1));
    }
  }
  if (lastRes) return lastRes;
  throw lastErr instanceof Error ? lastErr : new Error("All RPC endpoints failed");
}

let conn: Connection | null = null;

export function getConnection(): Connection {
  if (!conn) {
    conn = new Connection(pool()[0].url, {
      commitment: "confirmed",
      fetch: failoverFetch as unknown as typeof fetch,
      disableRetryOnRateLimit: true,
    });
  }
  return conn;
}

/** Forward one raw JSON-RPC body through the pool. Used by the browser proxy route. */
export async function rpcRaw(body: string): Promise<{ status: number; text: string }> {
  const res = await failoverFetch("pool", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body,
  });
  return { status: res.status, text: await res.text() };
}

export function rpcStatus() {
  const now = Date.now();
  return pool().map((e) => ({
    host: maskUrl(e.url),
    healthy: e.cooldownUntil <= now,
    cooldownMs: Math.max(0, e.cooldownUntil - now),
    consecutiveFails: e.fails,
    lastError: e.lastError,
    lastMs: e.lastMs,
    calls: e.calls,
  }));
}

export function __rpcReset() {
  eps = null;
  conn = null;
}

import { PublicKey } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { MIN_CHARITY_BPS, MAX_CHARITY_BPS } from "./config";

export type ShareInput = {
  devWallet: string;
  charityWallet: string;
  charityBps: number;
  platformWallet?: string;
  platformBps?: number;
};

export type Share = { address: PublicKey; shareBps: number };

function pk(label: string, v: string): PublicKey {
  try {
    return new PublicKey(v);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Invalid ${label} wallet`);
  }
}

/**
 * Builds the final shareholder list for pump.fun fee sharing.
 * charityBps and platformBps are basis points of TOTAL creator fees. Dev gets the rest.
 * Throws on any invalid input. Sum is always exactly 10000.
 */
export function computeShares(i: ShareInput): Share[] {
  const platformBps = i.platformBps ?? 0;
  if (!Number.isInteger(i.charityBps)) throw new Error("Charity share must be a whole number of bps");
  if (i.charityBps < MIN_CHARITY_BPS || i.charityBps > MAX_CHARITY_BPS)
    throw new Error("Charity share must be between 50% and 100%");
  if (!Number.isInteger(platformBps) || platformBps < 0) throw new Error("Bad platform share");
  if (i.charityBps + platformBps > 10000) throw new Error("Charity plus platform share exceeds 100%");

  const dev = pk("dev", i.devWallet);
  const charity = pk("charity", i.charityWallet);
  if (dev.equals(charity)) throw new Error("Dev wallet cannot equal charity wallet");

  const out: Share[] = [{ address: charity, shareBps: i.charityBps }];

  if (platformBps > 0) {
    if (!i.platformWallet) throw new Error("PLATFORM_WALLET not set");
    const plat = pk("platform", i.platformWallet);
    if (plat.equals(charity)) throw new Error("Platform wallet cannot equal charity wallet");
    if (plat.equals(dev)) throw new Error("Platform wallet cannot equal dev wallet");
    out.push({ address: plat, shareBps: platformBps });
  }

  const devBps = 10000 - i.charityBps - platformBps;
  if (devBps > 0) out.push({ address: dev, shareBps: devBps });

  const total = out.reduce((a, s) => a + s.shareBps, 0);
  if (total !== 10000) throw new Error("Shares do not total 100%");
  return out;
}

import { kvGet, kvSet, kvLock, kvDel } from "./kv";
import { withTimeout, sleep } from "./util";

/**
 * Snapshots are the reason traffic never reaches the database.
 * Public reads come from a precomputed copy in Redis (L2) with a tiny in process copy (L1).
 * Only one caller per soft TTL rebuilds a snapshot (Redis lock). Everyone else gets the last good copy.
 * If the loader fails the last good copy is served, however old. The site never shows an error for reads.
 */

type Snap<T> = { v: T; at: number };

export type SnapOptions<T> = {
  /** Serve fresh data up to this age (seconds). After it one caller refreshes, others get stale. */
  softSec: number;
  /** Keep the stale copy this long (seconds). Default 24h. */
  hardSec?: number;
  /** Rebuilds the snapshot from the source of truth. */
  loader: () => Promise<T>;
  /** Returned when nothing at all exists yet and the loader fails. */
  fallback: T;
  loaderTimeoutMs?: number;
};

export type SnapResult<T> = { data: T; ageMs: number; source: "l1" | "kv" | "fresh" | "stale" | "fallback" };

const L1_MS = 1500;
const l1 = new Map<string, Snap<unknown>>();
const lastGood = new Map<string, Snap<unknown>>();
const inflight = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();

export const snapStats = { l1: 0, kv: 0, fresh: 0, stale: 0, fallback: 0, loaderErrors: 0 };

export async function getSnapshot<T>(key: string, o: SnapOptions<T>): Promise<SnapResult<T>> {
  const hard = o.hardSec ?? 86_400;
  const now = Date.now();

  const a = l1.get(key) as Snap<T> | undefined;
  if (a && now - a.at < L1_MS) {
    snapStats.l1++;
    return { data: a.v, ageMs: now - a.at, source: "l1" };
  }

  let s = (await kvGet<Snap<T>>(`snap:${key}`)) ?? (lastGood.get(key) as Snap<T> | undefined) ?? null;

  if (s && now - s.at < o.softSec * 1000) {
    l1.set(key, s);
    snapStats.kv++;
    return { data: s.v, ageMs: now - s.at, source: "kv" };
  }

  // Need a refresh. Only the lock holder does it.
  const won = await kvLock(`lock:${key}`, Math.max(5, Math.min(20, o.softSec)));
  if (!won && s) {
    snapStats.stale++;
    return { data: s.v, ageMs: now - s.at, source: "stale" };
  }

  if (!won && !s) {
    // Cold start and someone else is loading. Give them a moment to publish.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      await sleep(250);
      s = await kvGet<Snap<T>>(`snap:${key}`);
      if (s) {
        snapStats.kv++;
        return { data: s.v, ageMs: Date.now() - s.at, source: "kv" };
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    const fresh = await refresh(key, o, hard);
    return { data: fresh.v, ageMs: 0, source: "fresh" };
  } catch {
    snapStats.loaderErrors++;
    if (s) {
      snapStats.stale++;
      return { data: s.v, ageMs: Date.now() - s.at, source: "stale" };
    }
    snapStats.fallback++;
    return { data: o.fallback, ageMs: 0, source: "fallback" };
  }
}

async function refresh<T>(key: string, o: SnapOptions<T>, hard: number): Promise<Snap<T>> {
  // Collapse concurrent refreshes inside one process into a single loader call.
  const existing = inflight.get(key) as Promise<Snap<T>> | undefined;
  if (existing) return existing;

  const p = (async () => {
    const v = await withTimeout(o.loader(), o.loaderTimeoutMs ?? 5000, `snapshot ${key}`);
    const snap: Snap<T> = { v, at: Date.now() };
    l1.set(key, snap);
    lastGood.set(key, snap);
    await kvSet(`snap:${key}`, snap, hard);
    return snap;
  })();

  inflight.set(key, p);
  try {
    return await p;
  } finally {
    inflight.delete(key);
  }
}

/** Force a rebuild now (worker and admin use this). Does not take the lock. */
export async function publishSnapshot<T>(key: string, value: T, hardSec = 86_400): Promise<void> {
  const snap: Snap<T> = { v: value, at: Date.now() };
  l1.set(key, snap);
  lastGood.set(key, snap);
  await kvSet(`snap:${key}`, snap, hardSec);
}

/** Drop a snapshot so the next read rebuilds it. Used after writes that must show immediately. */
export async function invalidateSnapshot(key: string): Promise<void> {
  l1.delete(key);
  lastGood.delete(key);
  await kvDel(`snap:${key}`);
}

export async function snapshotAge(key: string): Promise<number | null> {
  const s = await kvGet<Snap<unknown>>(`snap:${key}`);
  return s ? Date.now() - s.at : null;
}

export function __snapReset() {
  l1.clear();
  lastGood.clear();
  inflight.clear();
  for (const k of Object.keys(snapStats) as (keyof typeof snapStats)[]) snapStats[k] = 0;
}

import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";

// Stateless signed ticket issued by /api/launch/prepare and required by /api/launch/register.
// Stops anyone registering a coin with a spoofed name, symbol, image or charity.

export type Ticket = {
  mint: string;
  creator: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  image: string | null;
  description: string;
  charitySlug: string;
  charityBps: number;
  exp: number;
};

function secret(): string {
  const s = process.env.REGISTER_SECRET;
  if (!s || s.length < 16) throw new Error("REGISTER_SECRET not set (min 16 chars)");
  return s;
}

const b64 = (b: Buffer | string) => Buffer.from(b).toString("base64url");

export function signTicket(t: Omit<Ticket, "exp">, ttlSeconds = 1800): string {
  const body = b64(JSON.stringify({ ...t, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + ttlSeconds }));
  const sig = createHmac("sha256", secret()).update(body).digest("base64url");
  return `${body}.${sig}`;
}

export function verifyTicket(token: string): Ticket | null {
  const [body, sig] = token.split(".");
  if (!body || !sig) return null;
  const expect = createHmac("sha256", secret()).update(body).digest();
  let got: Buffer;
  try {
    got = Buffer.from(sig, "base64url");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (got.length !== expect.length || !timingSafeEqual(got, expect)) return null;
  try {
    const t = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as Ticket;
    if (typeof t.exp !== "number" || t.exp < Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return null;
    return t;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

import { PublicKey } from "@solana/web3.js";
import type { Connection, VersionedTransactionResponse } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { PUMP_SDK, bondingCurvePda, pumpIdl } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";
import { kvGet, kvSet } from "./kv";
import { getConnection } from "./rpc";
import { getSnapshot } from "./snapshot";

import type { Trade } from "./candles";
export type { Trade } from "./candles";

/**
 * Our own chart data. Reads the coin's bonding curve trades straight from the chain,
 * so a brand new coin has a chart from its first trade. No indexer in between.
 *
 * A trade is stored as [unixSeconds, priceSol, solAmount, isBuy 1/0].
 * Price is SOL per whole token, from the curve reserves right after the trade.
 */
type Stored = { trades: Trade[]; newestSig: string | null };

const TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6;
const MAX_TRADES = 3000;
const MAX_TX_PER_REFRESH = 300;
const CHUNK = 20;

const tradeDisc = Buffer.from(
  (pumpIdl as { events: { name: string; discriminator: number[] }[] }).events.find((e) => e.name === "TradeEvent")!.discriminator,
);

/** Pure. Pulls this coin's trade events out of a transaction's log lines. */
export function tradesFromLogs(logs: string[], mint: PublicKey, fallbackTime: number): Trade[] {
  const out: Trade[] = [];
  for (const line of logs) {
    if (!line.startsWith("Program data: ")) continue;
    const data = Buffer.from(line.slice("Program data: ".length), "base64");
    if (data.length < 9 || !data.subarray(0, 8).equals(tradeDisc)) continue;
    try {
      const e = PUMP_SDK.decodeTradeEventBc(data.subarray(8));
      if (!e.mint.equals(mint)) continue;
      const vSol = Number(e.virtualSolReserves.toString()) / 1e9;
      const vTok = Number(e.virtualTokenReserves.toString()) / 10 ** TOKEN_DECIMALS;
      if (!(vSol > 0) || !(vTok > 0)) continue;
      const ts = Number(e.timestamp.toString()) || fallbackTime;
      out.push([ts, vSol / vTok, Number(e.solAmount.toString()) / 1e9, e.isBuy ? 1 : 0]);
    } catch {
      /* not a decodable trade event, skip */
    }
  }
  return out;
}

async function fetchTxs(conn: Connection, sigs: string[]): Promise<(VersionedTransactionResponse | null)[]> {
  try {
    return await conn.getTransactions(sigs, { commitment: "confirmed", maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0 });
  } catch {
    // Some RPC plans refuse batches. Fall back to one by one.
    return Promise.all(
      sigs.map((s) => conn.getTransaction(s, { commitment: "confirmed", maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0 }).catch(() => null)),
    );
  }
}

/** Reads only what is new since the last refresh, then stores the result. */
async function refreshTrades(mintStr: string): Promise<Trade[]> {
  const mint = new PublicKey(mintStr);
  const conn = getConnection();
  const key = `trades:${mintStr}`;
  const prev = (await kvGet<Stored>(key)) ?? { trades: [], newestSig: null };

  const sigInfos = await conn.getSignaturesForAddress(
    bondingCurvePda(mint),
    { limit: prev.newestSig ? 200 : 1000, ...(prev.newestSig ? { until: prev.newestSig } : {}) },
    "confirmed",
  );
  if (sigInfos.length === 0) return prev.trades;

  // Newest first from the RPC. Failed transactions never traded.
  const ok = sigInfos.filter((s) => !s.err).slice(0, MAX_TX_PER_REFRESH);
  const fresh: Trade[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < ok.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const part = ok.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    const txs = await fetchTxs(conn, part.map((p) => p.signature));
    txs.forEach((tx, j) => {
      const logs = tx?.meta?.logMessages;
      if (!logs) return;
      fresh.push(...tradesFromLogs(logs, mint, part[j].blockTime ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)));
    });
  }

  const merged = [...prev.trades, ...fresh].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).slice(-MAX_TRADES);
  await kvSet(key, { trades: merged, newestSig: sigInfos[0].signature } satisfies Stored, 60 * 60 * 24 * 30);
  return merged;
}

/** Cached for a few seconds, so many viewers cost one RPC refresh. */
export async function getTrades(mint: string): Promise<Trade[]> {
  const r = await getSnapshot<Trade[]>(`candles:${mint}`, {
    softSec: 8,
    hardSec: 3600,
    loader: () => refreshTrades(mint),
    fallback: [],
    loaderTimeoutMs: 15_000,
  });
  return r.data;
}

export class TimeoutError extends Error {
  constructor(label: string, ms: number) {
    super(`${label} timed out after ${ms}ms`);
    this.name = "TimeoutError";
  }
}

export function withTimeout<T>(p: Promise<T>, ms: number, label = "op"): Promise<T> {
  let t: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, rej) => {
    t = setTimeout(() => rej(new TimeoutError(label, ms)), ms);
  });
  return Promise.race([p, timeout]).finally(() => clearTimeout(t)) as Promise<T>;
}

export const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

export function jitter(ms: number, pct = 0.2): number {
  return Math.round(ms * (1 - pct + Math.random() * pct * 2));
}

export function maskUrl(u: string): string {
  try {
    const x = new URL(u);
    return x.host;
  } catch {
    return "invalid";
  }
}

export function ipOf(req: Request): string {
  const xf = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for");
  if (xf) return xf.split(",")[0].trim();
  return req.headers.get("x-real-ip") ?? "unknown";
}

// Admin mutations. Each one validates hard, writes an audit entry and refreshes the public snapshots

const ACTOR = "admin";

export class AdminError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public status = 400) {
    super(message);

const isHttps = (u: string) => {
  try {
    return new URL(u).protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }

export type CharityInput = {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  cause?: string;
  blurb?: string;
  site_url?: string;
  wallet?: string;
  wallet_source_url?: string;
};

export async function saveCharity(inp: CharityInput): Promise<CharityRow> {
  const slug = String(inp.slug ?? "").trim();
  if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,39}$/.test(slug)) throw new AdminError("Slug: 3 to 40 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, dashes");
  const name = String(inp.name ?? "").trim();
  if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 80) throw new AdminError("Name must be 2 to 80 characters");
  const cause = String(inp.cause ?? "").trim().slice(0, 40);
  const blurb = String(inp.blurb ?? "").trim().slice(0, 280);
  const site_url = String(inp.site_url ?? "").trim();
  const wallet = String(inp.wallet ?? "").trim();
  const wallet_source_url = String(inp.wallet_source_url ?? "").trim();

  if (site_url && !isHttps(site_url)) throw new AdminError("Website must be a https link");
  if (wallet_source_url && !isHttps(wallet_source_url)) throw new AdminError("Wallet source must be a https link");
  if (wallet && !validWallet(wallet)) throw new AdminError("Wallet is not a valid Solana address");

  const s = store();
  const existing = (await s.listCharities()).find((c) => c.slug === slug);

  // Changing a wallet, or its source, always drops verification. It must be verified again on purpose.
  const walletChanged = existing && (existing.wallet !== wallet || existing.wallet_source_url !== wallet_source_url);
  const verified = existing ? (walletChanged ? false : existing.verified) : false;

  await s.upsertCharity({ slug, name, cause, blurb, site_url, wallet, wallet_source_url, verified, active: existing?.active ?? true });
  await s.audit({
    actor: ACTOR,
    action: existing ? "charity.update" : "charity.create",
    target: slug,
    detail: {
      walletChanged: Boolean(walletChanged),
      from: existing ? { wallet: existing.wallet, source: existing.wallet_source_url } : null,
      to: { wallet, source: wallet_source_url },
      verificationReset: Boolean(walletChanged && existing?.verified),
    },
  });
  await refreshPublicSnapshots();
  return (await s.listCharities()).find((c) => c.slug === slug)!;
}

export async function setCharityVerified(slug: string, verified: boolean): Promise<void> {
  const s = store();
  const c = (await s.listCharities()).find((x) => x.slug === slug);
  if (!c) throw new AdminError("Charity not found", 404);
  if (verified) {
    if (!validWallet(c.wallet)) throw new AdminError("Add a valid wallet first");
    if (!isHttps(c.wallet_source_url)) throw new AdminError("Add the https page where the charity publishes this wallet first");
    if (!isHttps(c.site_url)) throw new AdminError("Add the charity's official website first");
  }
  await s.upsertCharity({ slug, verified });
  await s.audit({
    actor: ACTOR,
    action: verified ? "charity.verify" : "charity.unverify",
    target: slug,
    detail: { wallet: c.wallet, source: c.wallet_source_url },
  });
  await refreshPublicSnapshots();
}

export async function setCharityActive(slug: string, active: boolean): Promise<void> {
  const s = store();
  const c = (await s.listCharities()).find((x) => x.slug === slug);
  if (!c) throw new AdminError("Charity not found", 404);
  await s.upsertCharity({ slug, active });
  await s.audit({ actor: ACTOR, action: active ? "charity.activate" : "charity.deactivate", target: slug, detail: {} });
  await refreshPublicSnapshots();
}

export type CoinAction = "hide" | "unhide" | "reverify";

export async function coinAction(mint: string, action: CoinAction): Promise<Coin> {
  const s = store();
  const c = await s.getCoin(mint);
  if (!c) throw new AdminError("Coin not found", 404);

  if (action === "hide") {
    await s.patchCoin(mint, { status: "hidden" });
  } else if (action === "unhide") {
    await s.patchCoin(mint, { status: c.verified_at ? "verified" : "pending", fail_reason: null });
  } else if (action === "reverify") {
    await s.patchCoin(mint, { status: "pending", fail_reason: null });
  } else {
    throw new AdminError("Unknown action");
  }

  await s.audit({ actor: ACTOR, action: `coin.${action}`, target: mint, detail: { name: c.name, previous: c.status } });
  await invalidateSnapshot(`coin:${mint}`);
  await refreshPublicSnapshots();
  return (await s.getCoin(mint))!;
}

export async function setFlags(patch: { launchPaused?: boolean; banner?: string }) {
  const s = store();
  const clean: { launchPaused?: boolean; banner?: string } = {};
  if (typeof patch.launchPaused === "boolean") clean.launchPaused = patch.launchPaused;
  if (typeof patch.banner === "string") clean.banner = patch.banner.trim().slice(0, 200);
  const next = await s.setFlags(clean);
  await s.audit({ actor: ACTOR, action: "flags.update", target: "site", detail: clean });
  await refreshPublicSnapshots();
  return next;
}

import { createHash, createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

// Single admin login. Password and session secret come from env vars, never from code or chat.
//   ADMIN_PASSWORD         the login password (use 20+ random characters)
//   ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET   signs the session cookie (32+ random characters). Rotating it logs everyone out.
// Cookie is httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure in production, 12 hours.

export const COOKIE = "gf_admin";
const TTL_SEC = 12 * 3600;

export function adminConfigured(): boolean {
  return Boolean(process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD && (process.env.ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET ?? "").length >= 32);
}

const sha = (s: string) => createHash("sha256").update(s).digest();

export function checkPassword(input: string): boolean {
  const pw = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD ?? "";
  if (!pw) return false;
  // Hash both sides so length differences do not leak and compare in constant time.
  return timingSafeEqual(sha(input), sha(pw));
}

function sign(body: string): string {
  return createHmac("sha256", process.env.ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET!).update(body).digest("base64url");
}

export function makeSession(): { value: string; maxAge: number } {
  const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + TTL_SEC, sid: randomBytes(8).toString("hex") })).toString("base64url");
  return { value: `${body}.${sign(body)}`, maxAge: TTL_SEC };
}

export function validSession(token: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (!token || !adminConfigured()) return false;
  const [body, sig] = token.split(".");
  if (!body || !sig) return false;
  const expect = Buffer.from(sign(body));
  const got = Buffer.from(sig);
  if (expect.length !== got.length || !timingSafeEqual(expect, got)) return false;
  try {
    const { exp } = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as { exp: number };
    return typeof exp === "number" && exp > Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function isAdmin(): boolean {
  return validSession(cookies().get(COOKIE)?.value);
}

/** For server components inside the admin panel. */
export function requireAdmin(): void {
  if (!isAdmin()) redirect("/admin/login");
}

function sameOrigin(req: Request): boolean {
  const origin = req.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return false;
  const host = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-host") ?? req.headers.get("host");
  try {
    return new URL(origin).host === host;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** For admin API routes. Returns a Response to send when access is denied, otherwise null. */
export function adminGuard(req: Request): Response | null {
  const deny = (status: number, error: string) =>
    new Response(JSON.stringify({ error }), {
      status,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store" },
    });
  if (!adminConfigured()) return deny(503, "Admin not configured");
  if (!isAdmin()) return deny(401, "Not signed in");
  if (req.method !== "GET" && !sameOrigin(req)) return deny(403, "Bad origin");
  return null;
}

export * from "./types";

export const postgresConfigured = () => Boolean(process.env.DATABASE_URL);

let cached: Store | null = null;

/**
 * Picks the data store.
 *  DEMO_MODE=1            seeded in memory store (previews, tests). A banner shows on every page.
 *  DATABASE_URL present   real Postgres (Neon or any provider). Wins over Supabase if both are set.
 *  Supabase env present   real database.
 *  neither                empty read only store. Pages render empty, writes are refused.
 */
export function store(): Store {
  if (cached) return cached;
  if (isDemo()) cached = createMemoryStore({ demo: true });
  else if (postgresConfigured()) cached = createPostgresStore();
  else if (supabaseConfigured()) cached = createSupabaseStore();
  else cached = createMemoryStore({ demo: false });
  return cached;
}

export function __storeReset() {
  cached = null;

// Small deterministic PRNG so the demo looks the same on every start.
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
}

export function createMemoryStore(opts: { demo: boolean }): Store {
  const s = state();
  if (opts.demo) seed(s);

  const store: Store = {
    kind: "memory",
    writable: opts.demo,

    async listCoins(o: ListCoinsOpts) {
      const statuses = o.statuses ?? ["verified"];
      let rows = [...s.coins.values()].filter((c) => statuses.includes(c.status));
      if (o.charitySlug) rows = rows.filter((c) => c.charity_slug === o.charitySlug);
      rows.sort((a, b) =>
        o.order === "donated"
          ? b.total_donated_lamports - a.total_donated_lamports
          : b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at),
      );
      return rows.slice(0, o.limit).map((c) => ({ ...c }));
    },
    async getCoin(mint) {
      const c = s.coins.get(mint);
      return c ? { ...c } : null;
    },
    async upsertCoin(row) {
      const cur = s.coins.get(row.mint);
      s.coins.set(row.mint, {
        name: "",
        symbol: "",
        image_url: null,
        description: null,
        creator_wallet: "",
        charity_slug: "",
        charity_wallet: "",
        charity_bps: 5000,
        platform_bps: 0,
        status: "pending",
        fail_reason: null,
        total_donated_lamports: 0,
        launch_signature: null,
        verified_at: null,
        last_checked_at: null,
        created_at: nowIso(),
        ...(cur ?? {}),
        ...row,
      } as Coin);
    },
    async patchCoin(mint, patch) {
      const c = s.coins.get(mint);
      if (c) s.coins.set(mint, { ...c, ...patch });
    },
    async coinsForWorker() {
      return [...s.coins.values()].filter((c) => c.status === "pending" || c.status === "verified");
    },
    async coinCounts(): Promise<CoinCounts> {
      const out: CoinCounts = { pending: 0, verified: 0, failed: 0, revoked: 0, hidden: 0 };
      for (const c of s.coins.values()) out[c.status]++;
      return out;
    },

    async listPayouts(mint, limit) {
      return s.payouts.filter((p) => p.mint === mint).slice(0, limit);
    },
    async recentPayouts(limit): Promise<PayoutWithCoin[]> {
      return s.payouts
        .filter((p) => s.coins.get(p.mint)?.status === "verified")
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map((p) => {
          const c = s.coins.get(p.mint)!;
          return { ...p, coin_name: c.name, coin_symbol: c.symbol, charity_slug: c.charity_slug };
        });
    },
    async insertPayout(p) {
      if (s.payouts.some((x) => x.signature === p.signature)) return "duplicate";
      s.payouts.unshift(p);
      return "inserted";
    },
    async addDonation(mint, lamports) {
      const c = s.coins.get(mint);
      if (c) c.total_donated_lamports += lamports;
    },
    async charityTotals(): Promise<CharityTotal[]> {
      const out = new Map<string, CharityTotal>();
      for (const c of s.coins.values()) {
        if (c.status !== "verified") continue;
        const t = out.get(c.charity_slug) ?? { charity_slug: c.charity_slug, coins: 0, lamports: 0 };
        t.coins++;
        t.lamports += c.total_donated_lamports;
        out.set(c.charity_slug, t);
      }
      return [...out.values()];
    },

    async listCharities() {
      return [...s.charities.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    },
    async upsertCharity(c) {
      const cur = s.charities.get(c.slug);
      s.charities.set(c.slug, {
        name: "",
        cause: "",
        blurb: "",
        site_url: "",
        wallet: "",
        wallet_source_url: "",
        verified: false,
        active: true,
        created_at: nowIso(),
        ...(cur ?? {}),
        ...c,
        updated_at: nowIso(),
      } as CharityRow);
    },

    async getFlags() {
      return { ...s.flags };
    },
    async setFlags(patch) {
      s.flags = { ...s.flags, ...patch };
      return { ...s.flags };
    },

    async audit(e) {
      s.audit.unshift({ ...e, id: ++s.auditSeq, at: nowIso() });
      s.audit = s.audit.slice(0, 500);
    },
    async listAudit(limit) {
      return s.audit.slice(0, limit);
    },

    async ping() {
      return true;
    },
  };

  if (opts.demo) {
    // Makes the live feed move in previews. Roughly one event per call that wins the dice roll.
    store.demoTick = async () => {
      const verified = [...s.coins.values()].filter((c) => c.status === "verified");
      if (verified.length === 0) return;
      const roll = Math.random();
      if (roll < 0.7) {

        const lamports = Math.floor((0.01 + Math.random() * 0.5) * 1e9);
        s.payouts.unshift({
          signature: fakeSig(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)),
          mint: c.mint,
          charity_wallet: c.charity_wallet,
          lamports,
          created_at: nowIso(),
        });
        c.total_donated_lamports += lamports;
      } else if (roll < 0.8) {
        const idx = s.coins.size + 300;
        const ch = DEMO_CHARITIES[idx % DEMO_CHARITIES.length];

        const names = ["Mochi", "Sunny", "Pebble", "Marlin", "Fern", "Biscuit", "Nimbus", "Clover"];

          mint,
          name: nm,
          symbol: nm.split(" ")[0].toUpperCase().slice(0, 8),
          image_url: null,
          description: `Fresh launch supporting ${ch.name}.`,
          creator_wallet: addr(idx + 1000),
          charity_slug: ch.slug,
          charity_wallet: charity.wallet,
          charity_bps: 7000,
          platform_bps: 0,
          status: "verified",
          fail_reason: null,
          total_donated_lamports: 0,
          launch_signature: fakeSig(idx),
          verified_at: nowIso(),
          last_checked_at: nowIso(),
          created_at: nowIso(),
        });
      }
    };
  }

  return store;

import { Pool } from "pg";
import { dbBreaker } from "../breaker";
import { withTimeout } from "../util";
import type {
  AuditEntry,
  CharityRow,
  CharityTotal,
  Coin,
  CoinCounts,
  CoinStatus,
  Flags,
  ListCoinsOpts,
  Payout,
  PayoutWithCoin,
  Store,
} from "./types";

// Plain Postgres store (Neon, Railway, Render, anything). Server and worker only.
// Set DATABASE_URL. On Neon use the POOLED connection string (host contains "-pooler").
// Every query is timed out and goes through the circuit breaker, like the Supabase store.

const DB_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;

let pool: Pool | null = null;
function db(): Pool {
  if (!pool) {
    const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL!;
    const local = /localhost|127\.0\.0\.1/.test(url);
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString: url,
      // Serverless: few connections per instance. The provider pooler handles the rest.
      max: Number(process.env.DB_POOL_MAX || 3),
      idleTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
      connectionTimeoutMillis: 4000,
      ssl: local || /sslmode=disable/.test(url) ? undefined : { rejectUnauthorized: false },
    });
    pool.on("error", (e) => console.error("pg pool error", e.message));
  }
  return pool;
}

async function q<T = Record<string, unknown>>(label: string, text: string, params: unknown[] = []): Promise<T[]> {
  return dbBreaker.run(async () => {
    const r = await withTimeout(db().query(text, params), DB_TIMEOUT_MS, `db ${label}`);
    return r.rows as T[];
  });
}

const num = (v: unknown) => Number(v ?? 0);
const iso = (v: unknown) => (v instanceof Date ? v.toISOString() : (v as string | null));
const normCoin = (r: Record<string, unknown>): Coin => ({
  ...(r as unknown as Coin),
  total_donated_lamports: num(r.total_donated_lamports),
  verified_at: iso(r.verified_at),
  last_checked_at: iso(r.last_checked_at),
  created_at: iso(r.created_at) as string,
});
const normPayout = (r: Record<string, unknown>): Payout => ({
  ...(r as unknown as Payout),
  lamports: num(r.lamports),
  created_at: iso(r.created_at) as string,
});

// Build "col = $n, ..." from an object. Column names come from our own code, never from users,
// but we still whitelist the shape to be safe.
const COL = /^[a-z_]+$/;
function setList(obj: Record<string, unknown>, start = 1) {
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).filter((k) => obj[k] !== undefined);
  keys.forEach((k) => {
    if (!COL.test(k)) throw new Error(`bad column ${k}`);
  });
  return { keys, sql: keys.map((k, i) => `${k} = $${i + start}`).join(", "), vals: keys.map((k) => obj[k]) };
}

export function createPostgresStore(): Store {
  return {
    kind: "postgres",
    writable: true,

    async listCoins(o: ListCoinsOpts) {
      const statuses = o.statuses ?? ["verified"];
      const params: unknown[] = [statuses];
      let where = "status = any($1)";
      if (o.charitySlug) {
        params.push(o.charitySlug);
        where += ` and charity_slug = $${params.length}`;
      }
      const order = o.order === "donated" ? "total_donated_lamports desc" : "created_at desc";
      params.push(Math.min(o.limit, 500));
      const rows = await q("listCoins", `select * from coins where ${where} order by ${order} limit $${params.length}`, params);
      return rows.map(normCoin);
    },

    async getCoin(mint) {
      const rows = await q("getCoin", "select * from coins where mint = $1", [mint]);
      return rows[0] ? normCoin(rows[0]) : null;
    },

    async upsertCoin(row) {
      const { keys, vals } = setList(row as Record<string, unknown>);
      const cols = keys.join(", ");
      const ph = keys.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`).join(", ");
      const upd = keys.filter((k) => k !== "mint").map((k) => `${k} = excluded.${k}`).join(", ");
      await q("upsertCoin", `insert into coins (${cols}) values (${ph}) on conflict (mint) do update set ${upd || "mint = excluded.mint"}`, vals);
    },

    async patchCoin(mint, patch) {
      const { keys, sql, vals } = setList(patch as Record<string, unknown>, 2);
      if (!keys.length) return;
      await q("patchCoin", `update coins set ${sql} where mint = $1`, [mint, ...vals]);
    },

    async coinsForWorker() {
      const rows = await q(
        "coinsForWorker",
        "select * from coins where status in ('pending','verified') order by created_at desc limit 2000",
      );
      return rows.map(normCoin);
    },

    async coinCounts() {
      const rows = await q<{ status: CoinStatus; n: string }>("coinCounts", "select status, count(*) as n from coins group by status");
      const out: CoinCounts = { pending: 0, verified: 0, failed: 0, revoked: 0, hidden: 0 };
      for (const r of rows) out[r.status] = num(r.n);
      return out;
    },

    async listPayouts(mint, limit) {
      const rows = await q("listPayouts", "select * from payouts where mint = $1 order by created_at desc limit $2", [mint, limit]);
      return rows.map(normPayout);
    },

    async recentPayouts(limit): Promise<PayoutWithCoin[]> {
      const rows = await q(
        "recentPayouts",
        `select p.*, c.name as coin_name, c.symbol as coin_symbol, c.charity_slug as charity_slug
         from payouts p join coins c on c.mint = p.mint
         order by p.created_at desc limit $1`,
        [limit],
      );
      return rows.map((r) => ({
        ...normPayout(r),
        coin_name: String(r.coin_name ?? ""),
        coin_symbol: String(r.coin_symbol ?? ""),
        charity_slug: String(r.charity_slug ?? ""),
      }));
    },

    async insertPayout(p) {
      const rows = await q(
        "insertPayout",
        `insert into payouts (signature, mint, charity_wallet, lamports, created_at)
         values ($1, $2, $3, $4, coalesce($5::timestamptz, now()))
         on conflict (signature) do nothing returning signature`,
        [p.signature, p.mint, p.charity_wallet, p.lamports, p.created_at ?? null],
      );
      return rows.length ? "inserted" : "duplicate";
    },

    async addDonation(mint, lamports) {
      await q("addDonation", "update coins set total_donated_lamports = total_donated_lamports + $2 where mint = $1", [mint, lamports]);
    },

    async charityTotals(): Promise<CharityTotal[]> {
      const rows = await q<{ charity_slug: string; coins: string; lamports: string }>(
        "charityTotals",
        `select charity_slug, count(*) as coins, coalesce(sum(total_donated_lamports),0) as lamports
         from coins where status = 'verified' group by charity_slug`,
      );
      return rows.map((r) => ({ charity_slug: r.charity_slug, coins: num(r.coins), lamports: num(r.lamports) }));
    },

    async listCharities() {
      const rows = await q("listCharities", "select * from charities order by name asc");
      return rows.map((r) => ({ ...(r as unknown as CharityRow), created_at: iso(r.created_at) as string, updated_at: iso(r.updated_at) as string }));
    },

    async upsertCharity(ch) {
      // Update first, so partial patches like {slug, verified} work. Insert only if the row is new.
      const row = { ...ch, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() } as Record<string, unknown>;
      const { slug, ...rest } = row;
      const u = setList(rest, 2);
      const upd = await q("upsertCharity", `update charities set ${u.sql} where slug = $1 returning slug`, [slug, ...u.vals]);
      if (upd.length) return;
      const ins = setList(row);
      await q(
        "upsertCharity",
        `insert into charities (${ins.keys.join(", ")}) values (${ins.keys.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`).join(", ")}) on conflict (slug) do nothing`,
        ins.vals,
      );
    },

    async getFlags(): Promise<Flags> {
      const rows = await q<{ value: Partial<Flags> }>("getFlags", "select value from flags where key = 'site'");
      return { launchPaused: false, banner: "", ...(rows[0]?.value ?? {}) };
    },

    async setFlags(patch) {
      const next = { ...(await this.getFlags()), ...patch };
      await q(
        "setFlags",
        "insert into flags (key, value) values ('site', $1::jsonb) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value",
        [JSON.stringify(next)],
      );
      return next;
    },

    async audit(e) {
      await q("audit", "insert into audit_log (actor, action, target, detail) values ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)", [
        e.actor,
        e.action,
        e.target,
        JSON.stringify(e.detail ?? {}),
      ]);
    },

    async listAudit(limit): Promise<AuditEntry[]> {
      const rows = await q("listAudit", "select * from audit_log order by id desc limit $1", [limit]);
      return rows.map((r) => ({ ...(r as unknown as AuditEntry), id: num(r.id), at: iso(r.at) as string }));
    },

    async ping() {
      try {
        await q("ping", "select 1");
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
  };

import { createClient, SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { dbBreaker } from "../breaker";
import { withTimeout } from "../util";
import type {
  AuditEntry,
  CharityRow,
  CharityTotal,
  Coin,
  CoinCounts,
  CoinStatus,
  Flags,
  ListCoinsOpts,
  Payout,
  PayoutWithCoin,
  Store,
} from "./types";

// Server only. Uses the service role key. Never import from client code.
// Every call is timed out and goes through the circuit breaker, so a slow or dead database
// fails fast and the snapshot layer serves stale data instead of piling up requests.

const DB_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;

let client: SupabaseClient | null = null;
function sb(): SupabaseClient {
  if (!client) {
    client = createClient(process.env.SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!, {
      auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
      global: { fetch: (i, init) => fetch(i, { ...init, cache: "no-store" }) },
    });
  }
  return client;
}

type Res<T> = { data: T | null; error: { message: string; code?: string } | null };

async function q<T>(label: string, fn: (c: SupabaseClient) => PromiseLike<Res<T>>): Promise<T> {
  return dbBreaker.run(async () => {
    const { data, error } = await withTimeout(Promise.resolve(fn(sb())), DB_TIMEOUT_MS, `db ${label}`);
    if (error) throw new Error(`${label}: ${error.message}`);
    return data as T;
  });
}

const normPayout = (r: Record<string, unknown>): Payout => ({ ...(r as unknown as Payout), lamports: num(r.lamports) });

export function createSupabaseStore(): Store {
  return {
    kind: "supabase",
    writable: true,

    async listCoins(o: ListCoinsOpts) {
      const rows = await q<Record<string, unknown>[]>("listCoins", (c) => {
        let b = c
          .from("coins")
          .select("*")
          .in("status", o.statuses ?? ["verified"])
          .limit(Math.min(o.limit, 500));
        if (o.charitySlug) b = b.eq("charity_slug", o.charitySlug);
        b =
          o.order === "donated"
            ? b.order("total_donated_lamports", { ascending: false })
            : b.order("created_at", { ascending: false });
        return b;
      });
      return (rows ?? []).map(normCoin);
    },

    async getCoin(mint) {
      const r = await q<Record<string, unknown> | null>("getCoin", (c) =>
        c.from("coins").select("*").eq("mint", mint).maybeSingle(),
      );
      return r ? normCoin(r) : null;
    },

    async upsertCoin(row) {
      await q("upsertCoin", (c) => c.from("coins").upsert(row, { onConflict: "mint" }));
    },

    async patchCoin(mint, patch) {
      await q("patchCoin", (c) => c.from("coins").update(patch).eq("mint", mint));
    },

    async coinsForWorker() {
      const rows = await q<Record<string, unknown>[]>("coinsForWorker", (c) =>
        c
          .from("coins")
          .select("*")
          .in("status", ["pending", "verified"])
          .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
          .limit(2000),
      );
      return (rows ?? []).map(normCoin);
    },

    async coinCounts() {
      const rows = await q<{ status: CoinStatus; n: number }[]>("coinCounts", (c) => c.rpc("coin_counts"));
      const out: CoinCounts = { pending: 0, verified: 0, failed: 0, revoked: 0, hidden: 0 };
      for (const r of rows ?? []) out[r.status] = num(r.n);
      return out;
    },

    async listPayouts(mint, limit) {
      const rows = await q<Record<string, unknown>[]>("listPayouts", (c) =>
        c.from("payouts").select("*").eq("mint", mint).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(limit),
      );
      return (rows ?? []).map(normPayout);
    },

    async recentPayouts(limit): Promise<PayoutWithCoin[]> {
      const rows = await q<Record<string, unknown>[]>("recentPayouts", (c) =>
        c
          .from("payouts")
          .select("*, coins(name,symbol,charity_slug)")
          .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
          .limit(limit),
      );
      return (rows ?? []).map((r) => {
        const co = (r.coins ?? {}) as { name?: string; symbol?: string; charity_slug?: string };
        return {
          ...normPayout(r),
          coin_name: co.name ?? "",
          coin_symbol: co.symbol ?? "",
          charity_slug: co.charity_slug ?? "",
        };
      });
    },

    async insertPayout(p) {
      return dbBreaker.run(async () => {

          Promise.resolve(sb().from("payouts").insert(p)),
          DB_TIMEOUT_MS,
          "db insertPayout",
        );
        if (error) {
          if (error.code === "23505") return "duplicate" as const;
          throw new Error(`insertPayout: ${error.message}`);
        }
        return "inserted" as const;

    },

    async addDonation(mint, lamports) {
      await q("addDonation", (c) => c.rpc("add_donation", { p_mint: mint, p_lamports: lamports }));

    async charityTotals(): Promise<CharityTotal[]> {

    },

    async listCharities() {
      const rows = await q<CharityRow[]>("listCharities", (c) =>
        c.from("charities").select("*").order("name", { ascending: true }),
      );
      return rows ?? [];
    },

    async upsertCharity(ch) {
      // Update first, so partial patches like {slug, verified} work. Insert only if the row is new.
      const row = { ...ch, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      const { slug, ...rest } = row;
      const upd = await q<{ slug: string }[]>("upsertCharity", (c) =>
        c.from("charities").update(rest).eq("slug", slug).select("slug"),
      );
      if (upd && upd.length) return;
      await q("upsertCharity", (c) => c.from("charities").insert(row));
    },

    async getFlags(): Promise<Flags> {
      const r = await q<{ value: Partial<Flags> } | null>("getFlags", (c) =>
        c.from("flags").select("value").eq("key", "site").maybeSingle(),
      );
      return { launchPaused: false, banner: "", ...(r?.value ?? {}) };
    },

    async setFlags(patch) {
      const cur = await this.getFlags();
      const next = { ...cur, ...patch };
      await q("setFlags", (c) => c.from("flags").upsert({ key: "site", value: next }, { onConflict: "key" }));
      return next;
    },

    async audit(e) {
      await q("audit", (c) => c.from("audit_log").insert(e));
    },

    async listAudit(limit): Promise<AuditEntry[]> {
      const rows = await q<AuditEntry[]>("listAudit", (c) =>
        c.from("audit_log").select("*").order("id", { ascending: false }).limit(limit),
      );
      return rows ?? [];
    },

    async ping() {
      try {
        await q("ping", (c) => c.from("flags").select("key", { head: true, count: "exact" }).limit(1));
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
  };

// One time setup for dev buy. Creates an address lookup table holding the accounts every launch shares.
// Run:  npm run create-lut
// Needs env: HELIUS_RPC_URL (or RPC_URLS) and WORKER_SECRET_KEY (a funded wallet, about 0.01 SOL is enough).
// Then add the printed address to Vercel as LAUNCH_LUT and redeploy.
import { AddressLookupTableProgram, Connection, Keypair, PublicKey, Transaction, sendAndConfirmTransaction } from "@solana/web3.js";
import BN from "bn.js";
import { OnlinePumpSdk } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";
import { buildLaunchInstructions } from "../src/lib/pump";
import { computeShares } from "../src/lib/shares";
import { staticKeys } from "../src/lib/lut";

function loadEnv() {
  // tsx does not read .env.local on its own, so load it here (Node 20.12 or newer).
  for (const f of [".env.local", ".env"]) {
    try {
      (process as unknown as { loadEnvFile: (p: string) => void }).loadEnvFile(f);
    } catch {
      /* file missing, fine */
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  loadEnv();
  const rpc = process.env.HELIUS_RPC_URL || (process.env.RPC_URLS || "").split(",")[0];
  const raw = process.env.WORKER_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!rpc) throw new Error("HELIUS_RPC_URL is missing in .env.local (or RPC_URLS)");
  if (!raw) throw new Error("WORKER_SECRET_KEY is missing in .env.local");
  const payer = Keypair.fromSecretKey(Uint8Array.from(JSON.parse(raw)));
  const conn = new Connection(rpc, "confirmed");

  const global = await new OnlinePumpSdk(conn).fetchGlobal();
  const sample = async () => {
    const creator = Keypair.generate().publicKey;
    const shares = computeShares({
      devWallet: creator.toBase58(),
      charityWallet: Keypair.generate().publicKey.toBase58(),
      charityBps: 7000,
      platformWallet: Keypair.generate().publicKey.toBase58(),
      platformBps: 500,
    });
    const { create } = await buildLaunchInstructions({
      creator, mint: Keypair.generate().publicKey, name: "Sample", symbol: "SMP", uri: "https://example.com/m.json", shares,
      devBuy: { global, amount: new BN(1_000_000_000), solAmount: new BN(100_000_000) },
    });
    return create;
  };
  const keys = staticKeys(global, [await sample(), await sample(), await sample()]);
  console.log(`Table will hold ${keys.length} accounts. Paying from ${payer.publicKey.toBase58()}`);

  const slot = await conn.getSlot("finalized");
  const [createIx, table] = AddressLookupTableProgram.createLookupTable({ authority: payer.publicKey, payer: payer.publicKey, recentSlot: slot });
  await sendAndConfirmTransaction(conn, new Transaction().add(createIx), [payer]);
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i += 20) {
    const ext = AddressLookupTableProgram.extendLookupTable({ lookupTable: table, authority: payer.publicKey, payer: payer.publicKey, addresses: keys.slice(i, i + 20) as PublicKey[] });
    await sendAndConfirmTransaction(conn, new Transaction().add(ext), [payer]);
  }
  console.log("\nDone. Add this to Vercel env and redeploy:\n");
  console.log(`LAUNCH_LUT=${table.toBase58()}\n`);
}
main().catch((e) => { console.error(e.message || e); process.exit(1); });

// Usage: BASE=https://your-site npm run loadtest   (default http://localhost:3000)
import autocannon from "autocannon";

const base = process.env.BASE || "http://localhost:3000";
const paths = ["/", "/api/coins", "/api/stats", "/api/activity", "/charities", "/api/health"];
const conns = Number(process.env.CONNECTIONS || 200);
const secs = Number(process.env.DURATION || 20);

async function run(path: string) {
  const r = await autocannon({ url: base + path, connections: conns, duration: secs });
  const bad = r["4xx"] + r["5xx"] + r.errors + r.timeouts;
  const codes = Object.entries((r as unknown as { statusCodeStats?: Record<string, { count: number }> }).statusCodeStats ?? {})
    .map(([c, v]) => `${c}:${v.count}`)
    .join(" ");
  console.log(`${path.padEnd(16)} rps ${String(Math.round(r.requests.average)).padStart(6)}  p50 ${r.latency.p50}ms  p99 ${r.latency.p99}ms  non2xx ${r.non2xx}  errors ${r.errors}  timeouts ${r.timeouts}  codes ${codes || "200 only"}`);
  return bad;
}

(async () => {
  let bad = 0;
  for (const p of paths) bad += await run(p);
  console.log(bad ? "\nFAILED: errors under load" : "\nPASSED: no errors");
  process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);
})();

// Infra tests: KV fallback, Upstash protocol, snapshots, breaker, rate limit, RPC failover.
// No external network. Local mock servers stand in for Redis and RPC providers.
import http from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";
import { __kvResetMemory, kvGet, kvSet, kvLock, kvIncr, kvStatus } from "../src/lib/kv";
import { __snapReset, getSnapshot, snapStats } from "../src/lib/snapshot";
import { Breaker } from "../src/lib/breaker";
import { limit } from "../src/lib/ratelimit";
import { __rpcReset, failoverFetch, rpcStatus } from "../src/lib/rpc";
import { sleep } from "../src/lib/util";

let pass = 0;
let fail = 0;
const ok = (name: string, cond: boolean, extra?: unknown) => {
  console.log(cond ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name, cond ? "" : JSON.stringify(extra));
  cond ? pass++ : fail++;
};

function listen(handler: http.RequestListener): Promise<{ url: string; close: () => Promise<void> }> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const s = http.createServer(handler);
    s.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => {
      const port = (s.address() as AddressInfo).port;
      resolve({
        url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
        close: () => new Promise((r) => (s.closeAllConnections?.(), s.close(() => r()))),
      });
    });
  });
}

// Minimal Upstash REST protocol mock
function redisMock() {
  const store = new Map<string, { v: string; exp: number }>();
  const get = (k: string) => {
    const e = store.get(k);
    if (!e) return null;
    if (e.exp && e.exp < Date.now()) {
      store.delete(k);
      return null;
    }
    return e.v;
  };
  return listen((req, res) => {
    let body = "";
    req.on("data", (c) => (body += c));
    req.on("end", () => {
      const cmd = JSON.parse(body) as (string | number)[];
      const op = String(cmd[0]).toUpperCase();
      let result: unknown = null;
      if (op === "PING") result = "PONG";
      else if (op === "GET") result = get(String(cmd[1]));
      else if (op === "DEL") result = store.delete(String(cmd[1])) ? 1 : 0;
      else if (op === "SET") {
        const k = String(cmd[1]);
        const rest = cmd.slice(3).map((x) => String(x).toUpperCase());
        const nx = rest.includes("NX");
        const exIdx = rest.indexOf("EX");
        const ex = exIdx >= 0 ? Number(cmd[3 + exIdx + 1]) : 0;
        if (nx && get(k) !== null) result = null;
        else {
          store.set(k, { v: String(cmd[2]), exp: ex ? Date.now() + ex * 1000 : 0 });
          result = "OK";
        }
      } else if (op === "EVAL") {
        const k = String(cmd[3]);
        const cur = Number(get(k) ?? 0) + 1;
        const prev = store.get(k);
        store.set(k, { v: String(cur), exp: prev?.exp || Date.now() + Number(cmd[4]) * 1000 });
        result = cur;
      }
      res.setHeader("content-type", "application/json");
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ result }));
    });
  });
}

async function main() {
  // ---------- KV memory fallback
  delete process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL;
  delete process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN;
  __kvResetMemory();
  await kvSet("a", { x: 1 }, 5);
  ok("kv memory set/get", (await kvGet<{ x: number }>("a"))?.x === 1);
  ok("kv memory lock first wins", (await kvLock("l1", 5)) === true);
  ok("kv memory lock second loses", (await kvLock("l1", 5)) === false);
  ok("kv incr counts", (await kvIncr("c1", 5)) === 1 && (await kvIncr("c1", 5)) === 2);

  // ---------- rate limiter
  let allowed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) if ((await limit("t", 10, 60)).ok) allowed++;
  ok("limiter allows exactly max", allowed === 10, allowed);

  // ---------- snapshot: single flight under concurrency
  __kvResetMemory();
  __snapReset();
  let loads = 0;
  const loader = async () => {
    loads++;
    await sleep(60);
    return { n: loads };
  };
  const results = await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: 200 }, () => getSnapshot("home", { softSec: 10, loader, fallback: { n: -1 } })),
  );
  ok("200 concurrent reads cause 1 loader call", loads === 1, loads);
  ok("all 200 got data", results.every((r) => r.data.n === 1));

  // ---------- snapshot: serves stale when loader fails, never throws
  __snapReset();
  let fail1 = false;
  const flaky = async () => {
    if (fail1) throw new Error("db down");
    return { n: 7 };
  };
  await getSnapshot("flaky", { softSec: 0.05, loader: flaky, fallback: { n: -1 } });
  await sleep(80);
  fail1 = true;
  __snapReset(); // clear L1 and lastGood, force KV path
  const stale = await getSnapshot("flaky", { softSec: 0.05, loader: flaky, fallback: { n: -1 } });
  ok("stale copy served when loader fails", stale.data.n === 7, stale);

  // ---------- snapshot: fallback when nothing exists
  __kvResetMemory();
  __snapReset();
  const fb = await getSnapshot("never", { softSec: 5, loader: async () => { throw new Error("x"); }, fallback: { n: 42 } });
  ok("fallback returned on cold failure", fb.data.n === 42 && fb.source === "fallback", fb);
  ok("loader errors counted", snapStats.loaderErrors >= 1);

  // ---------- breaker
  const b = new Breaker("t", 3, 100);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await b.run(async () => { throw new Error("x"); }).catch(() => {});
  let calls = 0;
  await b.run(async () => { calls++; }).catch(() => {});
  ok("breaker open blocks calls", calls === 0 && b.isOpen);
  await sleep(120);
  await b.run(async () => { calls++; });
  ok("breaker half open allows trial then closes", calls === 1 && !b.isOpen);

  // ---------- Upstash protocol against mock
  const rm = await redisMock();
  process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL = rm.url;
  process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN = "t";
  __kvResetMemory();
  await kvSet("obj", { hello: "world" }, 30);
  // remove local copy to prove the read goes through Redis
  const viaRedis = await kvGet<{ hello: string }>("obj");
  ok("upstash set/get roundtrip", viaRedis?.hello === "world", viaRedis);
  ok("upstash lock", (await kvLock("rl", 10)) === true && (await kvLock("rl", 10)) === false);
  ok("upstash atomic incr", (await kvIncr("ic", 10)) === 1 && (await kvIncr("ic", 10)) === 2);
  ok("kv reports redis kind", kvStatus.kind === "redis");

  // ---------- Redis dies: must degrade, not throw, and stay fast
  await rm.close();
  const t0 = Date.now();
  let threw = false;
  try {
    await kvSet("after", { ok: true }, 10);
    const v = await kvGet<{ ok: boolean }>("after");
    ok("redis down: falls back to memory copy", v?.ok === true, v);
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) await kvIncr("x", 10);
  } catch {
    threw = true;
  }
  ok("redis down: no exceptions", !threw);
  ok("redis down: stays fast", Date.now() - t0 < 6000, Date.now() - t0);
  ok("redis failures recorded", kvStatus.failures > 0);
  delete process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL;
  delete process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN;
  __kvResetMemory();

  // ---------- RPC failover
  const a = await listen((_q, r) => { r.statusCode = 429; r.end("rate limited"); });
  const bsrv = await listen((_q, r) => { r.setHeader("content-type", "application/json"); r.end(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, result: "from-b" })); });
  process.env.HELIUS_RPC_URL = a.url;
  process.env.RPC_URLS = bsrv.url;
  __rpcReset();
  const res = await failoverFetch("x", { method: "POST", body: "{}" });
  const j = (await res.json()) as { result: string };
  ok("rpc fails over from 429 to second provider", j.result === "from-b", j);
  const st = rpcStatus();
  ok("rpc marks 429 endpoint cooling down", st[0].healthy === false && st[0].cooldownMs > 0, st);
  const res2 = await failoverFetch("x", { method: "POST", body: "{}" });
  ok("rpc skips cooling endpoint next time", ((await res2.json()) as { result: string }).result === "from-b");
  ok("rpc status never leaks full url or key", st.every((e) => !e.host.includes("?") && !e.host.includes("/")));

  await a.close();
  await bsrv.close();
  console.log(`\n${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
}

  console.error(e);

let pumpMode: "ok" | "403" = "ok";

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  for await (const c of req) chunks.push(c as Buffer);
  const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
  const send = (code: number, obj: unknown) => { res.writeHead(code, { "content-type": "application/json" }); res.end(JSON.stringify(obj)); };
  if (req.url === "/pinning/pinFileToIPFS") {
    log.pinataFile++; log.auth = String(req.headers.authorization);
    if (pinataMode === "fail") return send(500, {});
    return send(200, { IpfsHash: "QmImageHash" });
  }
  if (req.url === "/pinning/pinJSONToIPFS") {
    log.pinataJson++;
    if (pinataMode === "fail") return send(500, {});
    log.json = JSON.parse(body.toString()).pinataContent;
    return send(200, { IpfsHash: "QmMetaHash" });
  }
  if (req.url === "/api/ipfs") {
    log.pump++;
    if (pumpMode === "403") return send(403, {});
    return send(200, { metadataUri: "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPump", metadata: { image: "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPumpImg" } });
  }
  send(404, {});
});

// Tests verifyOnChain against a mocked RPC. Encodes real SharingConfig accounts with pump's own IDL coder,
// so decode and verification logic run for real. Chain calls are mocked, nothing hits the network.
import { Connection, Keypair, PublicKey } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { getPumpFeeProgram } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";
import BN from "bn.js";
import { verifyOnChain } from "../src/lib/pump";
import { feeSharingConfigPda } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";

const conn = new Connection("http://127.0.0.1:1");
const prog = getPumpFeeProgram(conn);
const k = () => Keypair.generate().publicKey;

async function encode(mint: PublicKey, admin: PublicKey, adminRevoked: boolean, sh: { address: PublicKey; shareBps: number }[]) {
  const idlAcc = (prog.idl.accounts ?? []).find((a) => a.name.toLowerCase() === "sharingconfig");
  if (!idlAcc) throw new Error("no sharingConfig account in IDL");
  const body = await (prog.coder.accounts as any).encode(idlAcc.name, {
    bump: 255,
    version: 2,
    status: { active: {} },
    mint,
    admin,
    adminRevoked,
    shareholders: sh,
  });
  return body as Buffer;
}

function mockConn(mint: PublicKey, data: Buffer | null) {
  const addr = feeSharingConfigPda(mint).toBase58();
  return {
    getAccountInfo: async (a: PublicKey) =>
      a.toBase58() === addr && data
        ? { data, executable: false, lamports: 1, owner: PublicKey.default }
        : null,
    // fetchBondingCurve path is wrapped in try/catch in verifyOnChain; make it throw (treated as unreadable)
    getMultipleAccountsInfo: async () => {
      throw new Error("mock");
    },
    getAccountInfoAndContext: async () => {
      throw new Error("mock");
    },
  } as unknown as Connection;
}

const ok = (n: string, c: boolean, extra?: unknown) => {
  console.log(c ? "PASS" : "FAIL", n, c ? "" : JSON.stringify(extra));
  c ? pass++ : fail++;
};

async function main() {
  const mint = k();
  const dev = k();
  const charity = k();
  const plat = k();

  // 1) good: locked, charity 70%
  let buf = await encode(mint, dev, true, [
    { address: charity, shareBps: 7000 },
    { address: plat, shareBps: 500 },
    { address: dev, shareBps: 2500 },
  ]);
  let r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("locked + 70% charity verifies", r.ok && r.locked, r);

  // 2) not locked
  buf = await encode(mint, dev, false, [{ address: charity, shareBps: 7000 }, { address: dev, shareBps: 3000 }]);
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("unlocked split fails", !r.ok && !r.locked, r);

  // 3) charity under 50%
  buf = await encode(mint, dev, true, [{ address: charity, shareBps: 4000 }, { address: dev, shareBps: 6000 }]);
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("charity 40% fails", !r.ok, r);

  // 4) charity not a shareholder
  buf = await encode(mint, dev, true, [{ address: dev, shareBps: 10000 }]);
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("charity absent fails", !r.ok, r);

  // 5) no config
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, null), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("missing config fails", !r.ok && r.shareholders.length === 0, r);

  // 6) exactly 50% passes, 100% passes
  buf = await encode(mint, dev, true, [{ address: charity, shareBps: 5000 }, { address: dev, shareBps: 5000 }]);
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());

  buf = await encode(mint, dev, true, [{ address: charity, shareBps: 10000 }]);
  r = await verifyOnChain(mockConn(mint, buf), mint, charity.toBase58());
  ok("100% verifies", r.ok, r);

  console.log(`\n${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);

import { Keypair } from "@solana/web3.js";
import { store } from "../src/lib/store";
import { seedCharitiesIfEmpty } from "../src/lib/charities";
import { refreshPublicSnapshots } from "../src/lib/data";
import { getConnection } from "../src/lib/rpc";
import { kvSet } from "../src/lib/kv";
import { runTick } from "./tick";
import type { TickStats } from "./tick";

// Long running worker. Run on any always on host (Railway, Fly, a VPS) or use --once from a cron.
// Jobs:
//  1. every 10s: rebuild the public snapshots in Redis so visitors never wait on the database
//  2. every WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS: verify every coin's on chain split and trigger fee distribution
//  3. write a heartbeat the admin dashboard reads

const SNAP_EVERY_MS = 10_000;

function loadSigner(): Keypair | null {
  const raw = process.env.WORKER_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return Keypair.fromSecretKey(Uint8Array.from(JSON.parse(raw)));
  } catch {
    console.error("WORKER_SECRET_KEY is not a valid JSON secret key array");
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

type Beat = {
  at: number;
  startedAt: number;
  payer: string | null;
  lastTickAt: number;
  lastTick: TickStats | null;
  lastError: string;
  snapshotErrors: number;
  mode: "loop" | "once";
};

async function main() {
  const s = store();
  if (!s.writable) {
    console.error("No database configured. Set DATABASE_URL (or SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY).");
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const once = process.argv.includes("--once");
  const signer = loadSigner();
  if (!signer) console.warn("No WORKER_SECRET_KEY: verification only, distribution disabled");
  else console.log("worker payer", signer.publicKey.toBase58());

  const seeded = await seedCharitiesIfEmpty();
  if (seeded) console.log(`seeded ${seeded} placeholder charities`);

  const conn = getConnection();
  const chainEvery = Math.max(15, Number(process.env.WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS ?? 60)) * 1000;
  const beat: Beat = {
    at: Date.now(),
    startedAt: Date.now(),
    payer: signer?.publicKey.toBase58() ?? null,
    lastTickAt: 0,
    lastTick: null,
    lastError: "",
    snapshotErrors: 0,
    mode: once ? "once" : "loop",
  };

  const publishBeat = async () => {
    beat.at = Date.now();
    await kvSet("hb:worker", beat, 600).catch(() => {});
  };

  const snapLoop = async () => {
    try {
      await refreshPublicSnapshots();
    } catch (e) {
      beat.snapshotErrors++;
      beat.lastError = `snapshot: ${(e as Error).message}`.slice(0, 200);
      console.error("snapshot refresh failed", (e as Error).message);
    }
    await publishBeat();
  };

  const chainLoop = async () => {
    try {
      beat.lastTick = await runTick(conn, signer);
      beat.lastTickAt = Date.now();
      console.log(new Date().toISOString(), JSON.stringify(beat.lastTick));
    } catch (e) {
      beat.lastError = `tick: ${(e as Error).message}`.slice(0, 200);
      console.error("tick failed", (e as Error).message);
    }
    await publishBeat();
  };

  await snapLoop();
  await chainLoop();
  if (once) {
    // Scheduled mode (GitHub Actions). Exit explicitly so the job ends right away.
    process.exit(0);
  }

  // Never overlap runs of the same loop. A slow RPC must not stack up work.
  let snapBusy = false;
  let chainBusy = false;
  setInterval(async () => {
    if (snapBusy) return;
    snapBusy = true;
    await snapLoop().finally(() => (snapBusy = false));
  }, SNAP_EVERY_MS);
  setInterval(async () => {
    if (chainBusy) return;
    chainBusy = true;
    await chainLoop().finally(() => (chainBusy = false));
  }, chainEvery);
}

main();
