import {
  Connection,
  Keypair,
  PublicKey,
  Transaction,
  ComputeBudgetProgram,
  TransactionInstruction,
} from "@solana/web3.js";
import { OnlinePumpSdk, PUMP_SDK, feeSharingConfigPda, GLOBAL_PDA } from "@pump-fun/pump-sdk";
import { store } from "../src/lib/store";
import type { Coin } from "../src/lib/store";
import { MIN_CHARITY_BPS } from "../src/lib/config";
import { kvLock } from "../src/lib/kv";
import { confirmByPolling } from "../src/lib/confirm";

// Gate between distribute attempts per coin. Stored in KV so restarts and a second worker do not double fire.
const DISTRIBUTE_GATE_SEC = 10 * 60;

export type TickStats = {
  coins: number;
  verified: number;
  revoked: number;
  failed: number;
  distributed: number;
  errors: number;
};

export async function runTick(conn: Connection, signer: Keypair | null): Promise<TickStats> {
  const s = store();

  // Safety check. A bad RPC key or the wrong network returns "account not found" for everything,
  // which would wrongly revoke every coin. Read an account that always exists on pump.fun mainnet first.
  // If it is missing the RPC is wrong, so stop before changing anything.
  const probe = await conn.getAccountInfo(GLOBAL_PDA, "confirmed");
  if (!probe) throw new Error("RPC check failed: pump.fun global account not found. Wrong network or bad RPC key. Nothing was changed.");

  const coins = await s.coinsForWorker();
  const stats: TickStats = { coins: coins.length, verified: 0, revoked: 0, failed: 0, distributed: 0, errors: 0 };

  // 1) Re verify every split on chain, 100 accounts per RPC call.
  const valid: Coin[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < coins.length; i += 100) {
    const chunk = coins.slice(i, i + 100);
    const pdas = chunk.map((c) => feeSharingConfigPda(new PublicKey(c.mint)));
    const infos = await conn.getMultipleAccountsInfo(pdas, "confirmed");

    for (let j = 0; j < chunk.length; j++) {
      const c = chunk[j];
      const info = infos[j];
      let next: Coin["status"] = "pending";
      let reason: string | null = null;
      let isValid = false;

      if (!info) {
        next = c.status === "verified" ? "revoked" : "pending";
        reason = "Sharing config missing on chain";
      } else {
        const cfg = PUMP_SDK.decodeSharingConfig(info);
        const entry = cfg.shareholders.find((x) => x.address.toBase58() === c.charity_wallet);
        if (!cfg.adminRevoked) {
          next = c.status === "verified" ? "revoked" : "pending";
          reason = "Split is not locked";
        } else if (!entry || entry.shareBps < MIN_CHARITY_BPS) {
          // The locked split changed (for example a pump.fun CTO) or never matched. Pull the badge.
          next = c.status === "verified" ? "revoked" : "failed";
          reason = "Charity share missing or below 50 percent on chain";
        } else {
          next = "verified";
          isValid = true;
        }
      }

      // A moderator hid this coin. Keep it hidden, but still pay the charity if the split is valid.
      const status = c.status === "hidden" ? "hidden" : next;
      try {
        const patch: Partial<Coin> = { status, fail_reason: reason, last_checked_at: new Date().toISOString() };
        if (status === "verified" && c.status !== "verified") patch.verified_at = new Date().toISOString();
        await s.patchCoin(c.mint, patch);
      } catch (e) {
        stats.errors++;
        console.error("patch", c.mint, (e as Error).message);
        continue;
      }

      if (isValid) {
        valid.push(c);
        if (status === "verified") stats.verified++;
      } else if (status === "revoked") stats.revoked++;
      else if (status === "failed") stats.failed++;
    }
  }

  // 2) Distribute fees so charity wallets get paid on chain. Permissionless calls.
  if (signer) {
    const sdk = new OnlinePumpSdk(conn);
    for (const c of valid) {
      try {
        if (!(await kvLock(`distgate:${c.mint}`, DISTRIBUTE_GATE_SEC))) continue;
        const mint = new PublicKey(c.mint);
        const min = await sdk.getMinimumDistributableFee(mint, signer.publicKey);
        if (!min.canDistribute) continue;
        const sig = await distribute(conn, sdk, signer, mint);
        if (sig) {
          await recordPayout(conn, c, sig);
          stats.distributed++;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        stats.errors++;
        console.error("distribute", c.mint, (e as Error).message);
      }
    }
  }

  return stats;
}

async function send(conn: Connection, signer: Keypair, ixs: TransactionInstruction[]) {
  const { blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } = await conn.getLatestBlockhash("confirmed");
  const tx = new Transaction({ feePayer: signer.publicKey, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight });
  tx.add(ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitLimit({ units: 400_000 }), ...ixs);
  tx.sign(signer);
  const sig = await conn.sendRawTransaction(tx.serialize(), { skipPreflight: false });
  await confirmByPolling(conn, sig, lastValidBlockHeight);
  return sig;
}

async function distribute(conn: Connection, sdk: OnlinePumpSdk, signer: Keypair, mint: PublicKey) {
  const { instructions, sweepCount } = await sdk.buildDistributeCreatorFeesInstructions(mint, {
    payer: signer.publicKey,
  });
  try {
    return await send(conn, signer, instructions);
  } catch (e) {
    // If the whole list is too large for one legacy tx, send sweeps first then the distribute.
    if (sweepCount > 0 && /too large/i.test((e as Error).message)) {
      await send(conn, signer, instructions.slice(0, sweepCount));
      return await send(conn, signer, instructions.slice(sweepCount));
    }
    throw e;
  }
}

// The payout amount is read from the confirmed transaction itself: the charity wallet balance change.
async function recordPayout(conn: Connection, c: Coin, signature: string) {
  const tx = await conn.getTransaction(signature, { commitment: "confirmed", maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0 });
  if (!tx || !tx.meta || tx.meta.err) return;
  const keys = tx.transaction.message.getAccountKeys().staticAccountKeys.map((k) => k.toBase58());
  const idx = keys.indexOf(c.charity_wallet);
  if (idx < 0) return;
  const delta = tx.meta.postBalances[idx] - tx.meta.preBalances[idx];
  if (delta <= 0) return;

  const s = store();
  const r = await s.insertPayout({ signature, mint: c.mint, charity_wallet: c.charity_wallet, lamports: delta, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
  if (r === "inserted") await s.addDonation(c.mint, delta);
}

-- Give.fun schema for plain Postgres (Neon, Railway, Render, or any provider).
-- Run once. Safe to run again. Use this INSTEAD of the Supabase files when using DATABASE_URL.
-- No RLS: the database is only ever reached from our server and worker, never from the browser.

create table if not exists charities (
  slug text primary key,
  name text not null,
  cause text not null default '',
  blurb text not null default '',
  site_url text not null default '',
  wallet text not null default '',
  wallet_source_url text not null default '',
  verified boolean not null default false,
  active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists coins (
  mint text primary key,
  name text not null,
  symbol text not null,
  image_url text,
  description text,
  creator_wallet text not null,
  charity_slug text not null references charities(slug),
  charity_wallet text not null,
  charity_bps int not null check (charity_bps between 5000 and 10000),
  platform_bps int not null default 0,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','verified','failed','revoked','hidden')),
  fail_reason text,
  total_donated_lamports bigint not null default 0,
  launch_signature text,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  last_checked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists coins_status_created_idx on coins (status, created_at desc);
create index if not exists coins_charity_idx on coins (charity_slug);
create index if not exists coins_donated_idx on coins (status, total_donated_lamports desc);

create table if not exists payouts (
  signature text primary key,
  mint text not null references coins(mint),
  charity_wallet text not null,
  lamports bigint not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists payouts_mint_idx on payouts (mint, created_at desc);
create index if not exists payouts_created_idx on payouts (created_at desc);

create table if not exists flags (
  key text primary key,

-- Give.fun schema. Run once in the Supabase SQL editor (Trencher's paid project).
-- RLS: public read on everything. Writes only via service role (server and worker). No anon writes, ever.

create table if not exists charities (
  slug text primary key,
  name text not null,
  cause text not null default '',
  site_url text not null default '',
  wallet text not null default '',
  wallet_source_url text not null default '',
  verified boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists coins (
  mint text primary key,
  name text not null,
  symbol text not null,
  image_url text,
  description text,
  creator_wallet text not null,
  charity_slug text not null references charities(slug),
  charity_wallet text not null,
  charity_bps int not null check (charity_bps between 5000 and 10000),
  platform_bps int not null default 0,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','verified','failed','revoked')),
  fail_reason text,
  total_donated_lamports bigint not null default 0,
  launch_signature text,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  last_checked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists coins_status_created_idx on coins (status, created_at desc);
create index if not exists coins_charity_idx on coins (charity_slug);

create table if not exists payouts (
  signature text primary key,
  mint text not null references coins(mint),
  charity_wallet text not null,
  lamports bigint not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists payouts_mint_idx on payouts (mint, created_at desc);

alter table charities enable row level security;
alter table coins enable row level security;
alter table payouts enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "public read charities" on charities;
drop policy if exists "public read coins" on coins;
drop policy if exists "public read payouts" on payouts;
create policy "public read charities" on charities for select using (true);
create policy "public read coins" on coins for select using (true);
create policy "public read payouts" on payouts for select using (true);

-- Atomic increment used by the worker after a confirmed payout.
create or replace function add_donation(p_mint text, p_lamports bigint)
returns void language sql security definer as $$
  update coins set total_donated_lamports = total_donated_lamports + p_lamports where mint = p_mint;
$$;
revoke all on function add_donation(text, bigint) from public, anon, authenticated;

-- Migration 002. Run AFTER schema.sql in the Supabase SQL editor. Safe to run more than once.
-- Adds: editable charities, flags, audit log, hidden coin status, fast aggregate functions.

-- Charities become editable from the admin dashboard
alter table charities add column if not exists blurb text not null default '';
alter table charities add column if not exists active boolean not null default true;
alter table charities add column if not exists updated_at timestamptz not null default now();

-- Allow moderators to hide a coin
alter table coins drop constraint if exists coins_status_check;
alter table coins add constraint coins_status_check
  check (status in ('pending','verified','failed','revoked','hidden'));

-- Site wide flags (launch pause, banner)
create table if not exists flags (
  key text primary key,
  value jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
);
insert into flags (key, value) values ('site', '{"launchPaused": false, "banner": ""}')
  on conflict (key) do nothing;

-- Who changed what in the admin
create table if not exists audit_log (
  id bigserial primary key,
  at timestamptz not null default now(),
  actor text not null default 'admin',
  action text not null,
  target text not null default '',
  detail jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
);
create index if not exists audit_log_at_idx on audit_log (at desc);

alter table flags enable row level security;
alter table audit_log enable row level security;
-- No public policies on flags or audit_log. Only the service role (server) can read or write them.

-- Aggregates computed in the database, so the app never pulls every row
create or replace function charity_totals()
returns table (charity_slug text, coins bigint, lamports numeric)
language sql stable security definer as $$
  select charity_slug, count(*)::bigint, coalesce(sum(total_donated_lamports),0)::numeric
  from coins where status = 'verified' group by charity_slug;
$$;

create or replace function coin_counts()
returns table (status text, n bigint)
language sql stable security definer as $$
  select status, count(*)::bigint from coins group by status;
$$;

revoke all on function charity_totals() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function coin_counts() from public, anon, authenticated;

-- Indexes for the leaderboard and activity queries
create index if not exists coins_donated_idx on coins (status, total_donated_lamports desc);
create index if not exists payouts_created_idx on payouts (created_at desc);

# Free scheduled worker. Runs one verify and payout pass every 5 minutes.
# Needs these repository secrets (Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions):
#   DATABASE_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL, UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN, HELIUS_RPC_URL, WORKER_SECRET_KEY
# Free minutes are unlimited on PUBLIC repos. On private repos this would exceed the free quota.
name: worker

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/5 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: givefun-worker
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  tick:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 4
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run worker:once
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL: ${{ secrets.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL }}
          UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN }}
          HELIUS_RPC_URL: ${{ secrets.HELIUS_RPC_URL }}
          WORKER_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.WORKER_SECRET_KEY }}
          WORKER_MODE: once
